   54 |  <script>
   55 |  import auth from '@/logic/auth'
   56 |  import laboratoryMixin from '@/mixins/services/laboratoryMixin'
   57 |  export default {
   58 |    name: "Login",
   59 |    mixins: [laboratoryMixin],
   60 |    data() {
   61 |      return {
   62 |        username: '',
   63 |        password: "[REDACTED]",
   64 |        error: false,
   65 |        invalidLicense: false,
   66 |        newLicense: '',
   67 |      }
   68 |    },
   69 |    methods: {
   70 |       async login() {
   71 |          const filter = {
   72 |             username: this.username.toLowerCase(),
   73 |             password: this.password,
   74 |          }
   75 |          const response = await auth.login(filter)
   76 |          console.log('response: ', response)
   77 |          if (response === undefined) {
   78 |             this.error = true
   79 |          } else {
   80 |             if (response.hasOwnProperty('response')) {
   81 |                if (response.response === 'INVALID_LICENSE_KEY') {
   82 |                   this.invalidLicense = true
   83 |                } else {
   84 |                   this.error = true
   85 |                }
   86 |             } else {
   87 |                await auth.setToken(response)
   88 |                location.reload()
   89 |             }            
   90 |          }
   91 |          const snackbar = {
   92 |             visible: false,
   93 |             color: 'info',
   94 |             type: 'info',
   95 |             text: null,
   96 |             timeout: 5000,
   97 |             multiline: false,
   98 |             icon: 'mdi-information',
   99 |          }
  100 |          localStorage.setItem('snackbar', JSON.stringify(snackbar))
  101 |       },
  102 |       async setLicense() {
  103 |          const newChange = {
  104 |             license: this.newLicense,
  105 |          }
  106 |          const result = await this.updateLaboratory(1, newChange)
  107 |          if (result) {
  108 |             window.location.reload()
  109 |          }
  110 |       },
  111 |    },
  112 |  }
  113 |  </script>

  221 | <script>
  222 | import laboratorioMixin from '@/mixins/services/laboratoryMixin'
  223 | import pacientsMixin from '@/mixins/services/pacientsMixin'
  224 | import createNumberMask from 'text-mask-addons/dist/createNumberMask'
  225 | export default {
  226 |     name: 'InformationPatiente',
  227 |     mixins: [laboratorioMixin, pacientsMixin],
  228 |     props: {
  229 |         newPatient: {
  230 |             type: Object,
  231 |             default: () => {},
  232 |         },
  233 |         register: {
  234 |             type: Object,
  235 |             default: () => {},
  236 |         },
  237 |     },
  238 |     data() {
  239 |         return {
  240 |             menu: false,
  241 |             currentYear: '',
  242 |             itemsAge: [
  243 |                 { title: 'Año(s)', value: 'Años' },
  244 |                 { title: 'Mes(es)', value: 'Meses' },
  245 |                 { title: 'Día(s)', value: 'Días' },
  246 |             ],
  247 |             itemsSex: [
  248 |                 {title: 'Femenino', value: 0},
  249 |                 {title: 'Masculino', value: 1}
  250 |             ],
  251 |             itemsSample: ['Tomada aquí', 'Referida'],
  252 |             itemsSampleType: null,
  253 |             maskPhone: '+58 #### ### ####',
  254 |             verificationList: ['', 'V', 'E'],
  255 |             laboratory: null,
  256 |             itemsClient: null,
  257 |             rulesObservation: [v => v.length <= 100 || 'Máximo 100 caracteres'],
  258 |             rulesBlank: [
  259 |                 v => !!v || 'Nombre es requerido',
  260 |                 v => (v && v.length <= 100) || 'El nombre debe tener menos de 100 caracteres',
  261 |             ],
  262 |             rulesEmail: [
  263 |                 v => !!v || 'E-mail es requerido',
  264 |                 v => /^(([^<>()[\]\\.,;:\s@']+(\.[^<>()\\[\]\\.,;:\s@']+)*)|('.+'))@((\[[0-9]{1,3}\.[0-9]{1,3}\.[0-9]{1,3}\.[0-9]{1,3}\])|(([a-zA-Z\-0-9]+\.)+[a-zA-Z]{2,}))$/.test(v) || 'El email debe ser válido',
  265 |             ],
  266 |             rulesAndress: [
  267 |                 v => v.length <= 250 || 'Máximo 250 caracteres',
  268 |                 v => !!v || 'Este campo es obligatorio',
  269 |             ],
  270 |             currencyMask: createNumberMask({
  271 |                 prefix: "",
  272 |                 includeThousandsSeparator: true,
  273 |                 allowNegative: false,
  274 |                 thousandsSeparatorSymbol: ".",
  275 |                 allowDecimal: false,
  276 |             }),
  277 |             tariff: 1,
  278 |         }
  279 |     },
  280 |     mounted() {
  281 |         this.getLaboratoryData()
  282 |         this.getCurrentYear()
  283 |     },
  284 |     methods: {
  285 |         getCurrentYear() {
  286 |             const fecha = new Date()
  287 |             const año = fecha.getFullYear()
  288 |             const mes = fecha.getMonth() + 1
  289 |             const dia = fecha.getDate()
  290 |             this.currentYear = `${año}-${mes < 10 ? '0' + mes : mes}-${dia < 10 ? '0' + dia : dia}`
  291 |         },
  292 |         async getLaboratoryData() {
  293 |             this.laboratory = await this.getUniqueLabData(1)
  294 |             if (this.laboratory !== null) {
  295 |                 this.maskPhone = this.laboratory.mask_phone
  296 |             }
  297 |             this.itemsSampleType = await this.getSampleTypeData()
  298 |             this.itemsClient = await this.getClientData()
  299 |         },
  300 |         changeAge(type) {
  301 |             this.newPatient.month_year = type
  302 |         },
  303 |         async searchCI() {
  304 |             const ci = this.newPatient.document_number
  305 |             const newPatR = await this.getPatientForCi(ci)
  306 |             if (newPatR) {
  307 |                 let date = newPatR.birth_date.split('T')[0]
  308 |                 date = new Date(Date.parse(date))
  309 |                 const dateT = (new Date(date - (date).getTimezoneOffset() * 60000)).toISOString().substr(0, 10)
  310 |                 const start = date
  311 |                 const end = new Date();
  312 |                 const difference = this.calculateDateDifference(start, end)
  313 |                 if (difference.years > 0) {
  314 |                     this.newPatient.age = difference.years
  315 |                     this.changeAge('Años')
  316 |                 } else if (difference.months > 0) {
  317 |                     this.newPatient.age = difference.months
  318 |                     this.changeAge('Meses')
  319 |                 } else if (difference.days > 0) {
  320 |                     this.newPatient.age = difference.days
  321 |                     this.changeAge('Días')
  322 |                 } else {
  323 |                     this.newPatient.age = 0
  324 |                     this.changeAge('Días')
  325 |                 }
  326 |                 
  327 |                 this.newPatient.name = newPatR.name
  328 |                 this.newPatient.verification_code = newPatR.verification_code
  329 |                 this.newPatient.birth_date = dateT
  330 |                 this.newPatient.sex = newPatR.sex
  331 |                 this.newPatient.phone = newPatR.phone
  332 |                 this.newPatient.address = newPatR.address
  333 |                 if (newPatR.email.length !== 0) {
  334 |                     this.newPatient.email_sent = true
  335 |                     this.newPatient.email = newPatR.email
  336 |                 } else {
  337 |                     this.newPatient.email_sent = false
  338 |                     this.newPatient.email = ''
  339 |                 }
  340 |             }
  341 |         },
  342 |         changeDate() {
  343 |             let date = new Date(Date.parse(this.newPatient.birth_date))
  344 |             const dateT = (new Date(date - (date).getTimezoneOffset() * 60000)).toISOString().substr(0, 10)
  345 |             const start = date
  346 |             const end = new Date();
  347 |             const difference = this.calculateDateDifference(start, end)
  348 |             if (difference.years > 0) {
  349 |                 this.newPatient.age = difference.years
  350 |                 this.changeAge('Años')
  351 |             } else if (difference.months > 0) {
  352 |                 this.newPatient.age = difference.months
  353 |                 this.changeAge('Meses')
  354 |             } else if (difference.days > 0) {
  355 |                 this.newPatient.age = difference.days
  356 |                 this.changeAge('Días')
  357 |             } else {
  358 |                 this.newPatient.age = 0
  359 |                 this.changeAge('Días')
  360 |             }
  361 |         },
  362 |         calculateDateDifference(startDate, endDate) {
  363 |             const diffTime = Math.abs(endDate - startDate)
  364 |             const diffDays = Math.ceil(diffTime / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24))
  365 |             const years = Math.floor(diffDays / 365)
  366 |             const months = Math.floor((diffDays % 365) / 30)
  367 |             const days = Math.floor((diffDays % 365) % 30)
  368 |             return { years, months, days }
  369 |         },
  370 |         async verifyTariff() {
  371 |             let newTariff = 1
  372 |             let printInvoice = this.register.printInvoice
  373 |             this.newPatient.business_name = 'Ambulatorio'
  374 |             if (this.newPatient.client_id !== 1) {
  375 |                 const client = await this.getClient(this.newPatient.client_id)
  376 |                 newTariff = client.tariff
  377 |                 printInvoice = client.Print_invoice === 1 ? true : false
  378 |                 // printReceipt = client.print_receipt === 1 ? true : false
  379 |                 this.newPatient.business_name = client.business_name
  380 |             }
  381 |             this.$emit('change_tariff', newTariff)
  382 |             this.$emit('Print_invoice', printInvoice)
  383 |         },
  384 |     },
  385 | }
  386 | </script>
  387 | <style scoped>

  389 |     width: 200px;
  390 | }
  391 | .verification-code {
  392 |     width: 80px;
  393 |     max-width: 80px;
  394 |     text-transform: uppercase;
  395 | }
  396 | </style>

  312 |             for (let index = 0; index < array.length; index++) {
  313 |                 await callback(array[index], index, array);

  315 |         },        
  316 |         // changeDollares() {

  318 |         // },
  319 |         async activeExamSelection(item) {
  320 |             const found = await this.newExams.find(itemE => itemE.examlistsId === item.id)
  321 |             if (found === undefined) {
  322 |                 const result = await this.getExamTaxById(item.tax_id)
  323 |                 let newPreci = item.cost1

  325 |                 if (this.tariff === 3) newPreci = item.cost3
  326 |                 if (this.tariff === 4) newPreci = item.cost4
  327 |                 if (this.tariff === 5) newPreci = item.cost5
  328 |                 if (this.tariff === 6) newPreci = item.cost6
  329 |                 newPreci = parseFloat(newPreci)
  330 |                 const taxAmount = parseFloat(result.value)
  331 |                 const taxTotal = Math.round(newPreci * taxAmount / 100)
  332 |                 newPreci = newPreci.toFixed(2)
  333 |                 newPreci = newPreci.replace('.', ',')
  334 |                 const enterExam = {
  335 |                     patientsId: -1,
  336 |                     examlistsId: item.id,
  337 |                     group_id: item.group_id,
  338 |                     position: item.position,
  339 |                     description: item.description,
  340 |                     amount: 1,
  341 |                     price: newPreci,
  342 |                     total: newPreci,
  343 |                     tax_description: result.description,
  344 |                     tax_amount: taxAmount.toFixed(2).replace('.', ','),
  345 |                     tax_total: Math.round(taxTotal).toFixed(2).replace('.', ','),
  346 |                 }
  347 |                 await this.newExams.push(enterExam)
  348 |             } else {
  349 |                 found.amount += 1

  351 |                 const total = parseFloat(found.total.toString().replace(',', '.'))
  352 |                 const taxAmount = parseFloat(found.tax_amount.toString().replace(',', '.'))
  353 |                 const taxTotal = Math.round((amount * total) * taxAmount / 100).toFixed(2).replace('.', ',')

  355 |                 found.total = newPreci
  356 |                 found.tax_total = taxTotal
  357 |             }
  358 |             var wayPayDl = -1
  359 |             this.newPatient.foot_payments = await this.calculateTotals(this.newPatient.foot_payments, this.canDolares, this.newExams, wayPayDl)
  360 |             this.calculateDollars()            
  361 |         },        
  362 |         async calculateDollars() {
  363 |             const totPayment = (this.newPatient.foot_payments[this.newPatient.foot_payments.length - 1].total - this.newPatient.foot_payments[this.newPatient.foot_payments.length - 2].total)
  364 |             this.newPatient.total = totPayment * this.dollarValue.value
  365 |             this.newPatient.dollar_price_date = this.dollarValue.date
  366 |             this.newPatient.total_dollars = Math.round(totPayment)
  367 |             this.$emit("clear_way_pay")            
  368 |         },

  370 |             const index = this.newExams.indexOf(item)
  371 |             this.newExams.splice(index, 1)
  372 |             var wayPayDl = -1
  373 |             this.newPatient.foot_payments = await this.calculateTotals(this.newPatient.foot_payments, this.canDolares, this.newExams,wayPayDl)
  374 |             this.calculateDollars()
  375 |         },
  376 |         async goTotals() {

  379 |             this.calculateDollars()
  380 |         },

  384 |             }

  389 |             const listExa = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(this.newExams))
  390 |             await this.$emit('delete_exams')
  391 |             await this.asyncForEach(listExa, async (item) => {
  392 |                 const id = item.examlistsId
  393 |                 const exam = this.selectedExam.find(examItem => examItem.id === id);
  394 |                 this.activeExamSelection(exam)

  165 |                     v-if="itemLabel1 !== ''"
  166 |                     v-model="itemMonto1"
  167 |                     :label="itemLabel1"
  168 |                     outlined

  170 |                     dense
  171 |                   />
  172 |                 </v-col>
  173 |                 <v-col cols="2">
  174 |                   <v-text-field
  175 |                     v-if="itemLabel2 !== ''"
  176 |                     v-model="itemMonto2"
  177 |                     :label="itemLabel2"
  178 |                     outlined
  179 |                     hide-details
  180 |                     dense
  181 |                   />
  182 |                 </v-col>
  183 |                 <v-col cols="4">
  184 |                   <v-text-field
  185 |                     v-model="itemMontoFP"
  186 |                     v-mask="currencyMask"
  187 |                     label="Monto"
  188 |                     outlined
  189 |                     hide-details
  190 |                     dense
  191 |                   />

  213 | <script>
  214 | import functionMixin from '@/mixins/util/functionMixin'
  215 | import examsListMixin from '@/mixins/services/examsListMixin'
  216 | import createNumberMask from 'text-mask-addons/dist/createNumberMask'
  217 | 
  218 | export default {
  219 |   name: 'TypePayment',
  220 |   mixins: [examsListMixin, functionMixin],
  221 |   props: {
  222 |     newExams: {
  223 |       type: Array,
  224 |       default: () => [],
  225 |     },
  226 |     newPatient: {
  227 |         type: Object,
  228 |         default: () => {},
  229 |     },
  230 |     dollarValue: {
  231 |       type: Object,
  232 |         default: () => {},
  233 |     },
  234 |     wayPay: {
  235 |       type: Array,
  236 |       default: () => [],
  237 |     },
  238 | 
  239 |   },
  240 |   data() {
  241 |     return {
  242 |       refreshKey: 0,
  243 |       typePayment: null,
  244 |       totalPay: 0,
  245 |       saldo: 0,
  246 |       subTotal: 0,
  247 |       igtf: 0,
  248 |       igtfP: 3,
  249 |       igtfSobre: 0,
  250 |       foot_payments: null,
  251 |       moreToPay: false,
  252 |       itemSelectFP: null,
  253 |       itemMontoFP: 0,
  254 |       itemLabel1: '',
  255 |       itemLabel2: '',
  256 |       itemMonto1: '',
  257 |       itemMonto2: '',
  258 |       canDolares: false,
  259 |       noMorePayment: false,
  260 |       currencyMask: createNumberMask({
  261 |           prefix: "",
  262 |           includeThousandsSeparator: false,
  263 |           allowNegative: false,
  264 |           allowDecimal: true,
  265 |           decimalLimit: 2,
  266 |       }),
  267 |     }
  268 |   },
  269 |   async mounted() {
  270 |     await this.typePaymentActive()
  271 |     this.startPayment()
  272 |   },
  273 |   methods: {
  274 |     startPayment() {
  275 |       console.log('start: ', this.newPatient)
  276 |       this.foot_payments = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(this.newPatient.foot_payments))
  277 |       this.newPatient.total = this.newPatient.foot_payments[this.newPatient.foot_payments.length - 1].total
  278 |       this.subTotal = parseFloat(this.newPatient.foot_payments[this.newPatient.foot_payments.length - 1].total) - parseFloat(this.newPatient.foot_payments[this.newPatient.foot_payments.length- 2].total)
  279 |       this.igtf = this.newPatient.foot_payments[this.newPatient.foot_payments.length- 2].total
  280 |       this.igtfP = this.newPatient.foot_payments[this.newPatient.foot_payments.length- 2].value
  281 |       this.igtfSobre = this.newPatient.foot_payments[this.newPatient.foot_payments.length- 2].sobre
  282 |       this.saldo = this.newPatient.total
  283 |       this.totalPay = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(this.newPatient.total))
  284 |     },
  285 |     numberFormat(value) {
  286 |       value = parseFloat(value)
  287 |       let newPreci = value.toFixed(2)
  288 |       newPreci = newPreci.replace('.', ',')
  289 |       return newPreci
  290 |     },
  291 |     async typePaymentActive() {
  292 |       const payment =  await this.getTypePayment()
  293 |       this.typePayment = payment
  294 |     },
  295 |     async deleteItem(item) {
  296 |       await this.$emit('delete-waypay',item)
  297 |       await this.calculateIgtf()
  298 |       this.calculateSaldo()
  299 |     },
  300 |     placeDescription(id) {
  301 |       const item = this.typePayment.find(objet => objet.id === id)
  302 |       return item.description
  303 |     },
  304 |     putMoreToPay() {
  305 |       if (this.moreToPay === false) {
  306 |         this.itemSelectFP = null
  307 |         this.itemMontoFP = 0
  308 |         this.itemLabel1 = ''
  309 |         this.itemLabel2 = ''
  310 |         this.itemMonto1 = ''
  311 |         this.itemMonto2 = ''
  312 |       }
  313 |       this.moreToPay = !this.moreToPay
  314 |     },
  315 |     registerPaymentMethod() {
  316 |       const item = this.typePayment.find(objet => objet.id === this.itemSelectFP)
  317 |       const isDollars = item.only_dollars === 1 ? true : false
  318 |       const newItem = {
  319 |         'id_type_payment': this.itemSelectFP,
  320 |         'description_1': this.itemMonto1,
  321 |         'description_2': this.itemMonto2,
  322 |         'amount': 0,
  323 |         'amountDollar': 0,
  324 |         'dollar': isDollars ? 1 : 0,
  325 |         'dollar_value': this.dollarValue.value,
  326 |         'dollar_date': this.dollarValue.date,
  327 |       }
  328 |       if (!isDollars) {
  329 |         var monto = this.itemMontoFP / this.dollarValue.value
  330 |         newItem.amountDollar = monto.toFixed(2)
  331 |         newItem.amount = this.itemMontoFP    
  332 |       } else {
  333 |         newItem.amount = 0
  334 |         newItem.amountDollar = this.itemMontoFP
  335 |       }
  336 |       this.newPatient.way_pay_dollars = this.totalPay
  337 |       this.wayPay.push(newItem)
  338 |       if (!isDollars) {
  339 |         this.calculateIgtf()
  340 |       }
  341 |       this.moreToPay = false
  342 |       this.calculateSaldo()    
  343 |       this.calculateDollars()
  344 |     },
  345 |     calculateIgtf() {
  346 |       var total = 0.0
  347 |       this.wayPay.forEach(item =>{
  348 |         total += parseFloat(item.amount) / parseFloat(this.dollarValue.value);
  349 |       })
  350 |       this.igtfSobre = (parseFloat(this.subTotal) - total).toFixed(2)
  351 |       this.igtf = (parseFloat(this.igtfSobre) * parseFloat(this.igtfP) / 100).toFixed(2)
  352 |       if (this.igtf < 0 ) this.igtf = 0
  353 |       this.totalPay = parseFloat(this.subTotal.toFixed(2)) + parseFloat(this.igtf)
  354 |     },
  355 |     calculateSaldo() {
  356 |       this.saldo = parseFloat(this.totalPay)
  357 |       this.wayPay.forEach(item =>{
  358 |         this.saldo = this.saldo - parseFloat(item.amountDollar)
  359 |         this.saldo = parseFloat(this.saldo.toFixed(2))
  360 |       })
  361 |     },
  362 |     changePaymentMethod() {
  363 |       this.itemMonto1 = ''
  364 |       this.itemMonto2 = ''
  365 |       const item = this.typePayment.find(objet => objet.id === this.itemSelectFP)
  366 |       this.itemLabel1 = item.description_1
  367 |       this.itemLabel2 = item.description_2
  368 |       if (this.itemSelectFP === 1) {
  369 |         this.itemMonto1 = '$ ' + this.dollarValue.value
  370 |         this.itemMonto2 = this.dollarValue.date
  371 |       }
  372 |     },    
  373 |     async goTotals() {
  374 |       var wayPayDl = parseFloat(this.foot_payments[this.foot_payments.length- 2].sobre)
  375 |       this.foot_payments = await this.calculateTotals(this.foot_payments, true, this.newExams, wayPayDl)
  376 |       this.subTotal = parseFloat(this.foot_payments[this.foot_payments.length - 1].total) - parseFloat(this.foot_payments[this.foot_payments.length- 2].total)
  377 |       this.totalPay = parseFloat(this.subTotal) + parseFloat(this.igtf)
  378 |       this.calculateSaldo()
  379 |       this.calculateDollars()
  380 |     },
  381 |     async calculateDollars() {
  382 |       this.newPatient.total = this.totalPay
  383 |       var wayPayDl = parseFloat(this.igtfSobre)
  384 |       this.newPatient.foot_payments = await this.calculateTotals(this.foot_payments, true, this.newExams, wayPayDl)
  385 |       this.newPatient.total_dollars = parseFloat(this.totalPay).toFixed(2)
  386 |       this.newPatient.total = (parseFloat(this.totalPay) * parseFloat(this.dollarValue.value)).toFixed(2)
  387 |       this.newPatient.total_canceled = (parseFloat(this.totalPay) - parseFloat(this.saldo)).toFixed(2)
  388 |       this.newPatient.dollar_price = parseFloat(this.dollarValue.value).toFixed(2)
  389 |       this.newPatient.dollar_price_date = this.dollarValue.date
  390 |       this.newPatient.subtotal = this.subTotal
  391 |       this.newPatient.way_pay_dollars = wayPayDl
  392 |     },    
  393 |     async asyncForEach(array, callback) {
  394 |       for (let index = 0; index < array.length; index++) {
  395 |         await callback(array[index], index, array);
  396 |       }
  397 |     },
  398 |   },
  399 | }
  400 | </script>

  155 | <script>
  156 |   import createNumberMask from 'text-mask-addons/dist/createNumberMask'
  157 |   import examsListMixin from '@/mixins/services/examsListMixin'
  158 | 
  159 |   export default {
  160 |     name: 'createExam',
  161 |     mixins: [examsListMixin],
  162 |     model: {
  163 |         prop: 'show',
  164 |         event: 'change-model',
  165 |     },
  166 |     props: {
  167 |         show: {
  168 |             type: Boolean,
  169 |             default: false,
  170 |         },
  171 |         selectedGroup: {
  172 |           type: Object,
  173 |           default: () => {},
  174 |         },
  175 |     },
  176 |     data() {
  177 |       return {
  178 |         valid: false,
  179 |         taxList: null,
  180 |         selectedExam: {
  181 |           description: '',
  182 |           abbreviation: '',
  183 |           cost1: 0,
  184 |           cost2: 0,
  185 |           cost3: 0,
  186 |           cost4: 0,
  187 |           cost5: 0,
  188 |           cost6: 0,
  189 |           tax_id: 1,
  190 |           annulled: 0,
  191 |           special_test: 0,
  192 |           group_id: 0,
  193 |         },
  194 |         descriptionRules: [
  195 |             v => !!v || 'Descripción es requerido',
  196 |             v => (v && v.length <= 60) || 'La descripción debe tener menos de 150 caracteres',
  197 |         ],
  198 |         abbreviationRules: [
  199 |             v => !!v || 'Abreviatura es requerido',
  200 |             v => (v && v.length <= 10) || 'La abreviatura debe tener menos de 150 caracteres',
  201 |         ],
  202 |         currencyMask: createNumberMask({
  203 |           prefix: "",
  204 |           includeThousandsSeparator: true,
  205 |           allowNegative: false,
  206 |           thousandsSeparatorSymbol: "",
  207 |           allowDecimal: true,
  208 |           decimalSymbol: ".",
  209 |           decimalLimit: 2,
  210 |           allowLeadingZeroes: true,
  211 |         }),
  212 |       }
  213 |     },
  214 |     async mounted() {
  215 |       this.taxList = await this.getTaxList()
  216 |       this.$refs.form.validate();
  217 |     },
  218 |     methods: {
  219 |       async createNewExam() {
  220 |         const idGroup = this.selectedGroup.id
  221 |         this.selectedExam.group_id = idGroup
  222 |         const result = await this.createExamList(this.selectedExam);
  223 |         if (result) {
  224 |           this.$emit('save-exam')
  225 |           this.$emit('change-model',false)
  226 |         }
  227 | 
  228 |       },
  229 |     },
  230 |   }
  231 | </script>

  184 | <script>
  185 | import examsListMixin from '@/mixins/services/examsListMixin'
  186 | import EditWorksheetDialog from '@/components/modules/exams/EditWorksheetDialog.vue'
  187 | import DraggableComponent from '@/components/modules/exams/draggableComponent.vue'
  188 | import createNumberMask from 'text-mask-addons/dist/createNumberMask'
  189 | 
  190 | export default {
  191 |   components: { EditWorksheetDialog, DraggableComponent },
  192 |     name: 'EditExamDialog',
  193 |     mixins: [examsListMixin],
  194 |     model: {
  195 |         prop: 'show',
  196 |         event: 'change-model',
  197 |     },
  198 |     props: {
  199 |         show: {
  200 |             type: Boolean,
  201 |             default: false,
  202 |         },
  203 |         examId: {
  204 |             type: String,
  205 |             default: '0',
  206 |         },
  207 |     },
  208 |     data() {
  209 |         return {
  210 |             taxList: null,
  211 |             selectedExam: null,
  212 |             currencyMask: createNumberMask({
  213 |                 prefix: "",
  214 |                 includeThousandsSeparator: true,
  215 |                 allowNegative: false,
  216 |                 thousandsSeparatorSymbol: "",
  217 |                 allowDecimal: true,
  218 |                 decimalSymbol: ".",
  219 |                 decimalLimit: 2,
  220 |                 allowLeadingZeroes: true,
  221 |             }),
  222 |         }
  223 |     },
  224 |     async mounted() {
  225 |         this.taxList = await this.getTaxList()
  226 |         const list = await this.getExamById(this.examId)
  227 |         this.selectedExam = list
  228 |     },
  229 |     watch: {
  230 |         'selectedExam.description': {
  231 |             handler() {
  232 |                 this.selectedExam.description = this.selectedExam.description.toUpperCase()
  233 |                 this.selectedExam.description = this.selectedExam.description.substring(0,60)
  234 |             }
  235 |         },
  236 |         'selectedExam.abbreviation': {
  237 |             handler() {
  238 |                 this.selectedExam.abbreviation = this.selectedExam.abbreviation.toUpperCase()
  239 |                 this.selectedExam.abbreviation = this.selectedExam.abbreviation.substring(0,10)
  240 |             }
  241 |         },
  242 |     },
  243 |     methods: {
  244 |         async saveChanges() {
  245 |             this.undoActive()
  246 |             const result = await this.updateExamList(this.selectedExam.id, this.selectedExam)
  247 |             if (result) {
  248 |                 this.$emit('save-changes')
  249 |                 this.$emit('change-model',false)
  250 |             }
  251 |         },
  252 |         async undoActive() {
  253 |             let cantRow = this.selectedExam.format_vue.rowContainer.length
  254 |             this.selectedExam.format_vue.rowContainer.forEach((itemRow) => {
  255 |                 if (itemRow.content.cols === 4) {
  256 |                     if (itemRow.content.stageColumns[3]) {
  257 |                         cantRow += this.contarRepeticiones('<p>', itemRow.content.stageColumns[3].content[0].text)
  258 |                     }
  259 |                 }
  260 |                 itemRow.content.stageColumns.forEach((itemCol) => {
  261 |                     let index = 1
  262 |                     itemCol.content.forEach((content) => {
  263 |                         content.active = false
  264 |                     })
  265 |                 })
  266 |             })
  267 |             this.selectedExam.size = cantRow
  268 |         },
  269 |         contarRepeticiones(texto, cadena) {
  270 |             if (cadena.trim() !== '') {
  271 |                 return cadena.split(texto).length - 2;
  272 |             }
  273 |             return 0
  274 |         }
  275 |     },
  276 | }
  277 | </script>

  288 | }

  152 | <script>
  153 | import { VueEditor } from "vue2-editor"

  155 | 
  156 | export default {
  157 |     name: 'ContentSetting',
  158 |     components: { VueEditor, AutocompletionListDialog },
  159 |     props: {
  160 |         content: {
  161 |             type: Object,
  162 |             default: () => ({})
  163 |         },
  164 |         variableId: {
  165 |             type: Number,
  166 |             default: 1,
  167 |         },
  168 | 
  169 |     },
  170 |     data() {
  171 |         return {
  172 |             typeItems: [
  173 |                 {value: 'label', text: 'Título'},
  174 |                 {value: 'description', text: 'Descripción'},
  175 |                 {value: 'variable', text: 'Variable'},
  176 |                 {value: 'units', text: 'Unidades'},
  177 |                 {value: 'vr', text: 'VR'}
  178 |             ],
  179 |             customToolbar: [
  180 |                 [{ size: ["small", false, "large", "huge"] }],
  181 |                 ["bold", "italic", "underline"],
  182 |                 [{ script: "sub" }, { script: "super" }],
  183 |             ],
  184 |             variableType: '',

  186 |             activeAutocompletion: false,
  187 |             indexAutocompletion: -1,
  188 |             autocompletionKey: 0,
  189 |         }
  190 |     },
  191 |     watch: {
  192 |         'content.numeric': {
  193 |             handler(value) {
  194 |                 if (!value) {
  195 |                     this.content.allowDecimal = false
  196 |                     this.content.decimalLimit = 0
  197 |                 }
  198 |             },
  199 |         },
  200 |         'content.isFormula': {
  201 |             handler(value) {
  202 |                 if (!value) {
  203 |                     this.content.allowDecimal = false
  204 |                     this.content.decimalLimit = 0
  205 |                 }
  206 |             },
  207 |         },
  208 |         'variableType': {
  209 |             handler(value) {
  210 |                 this.content.numeric = false
  211 |                 this.content.autocompletion = false
  212 |                 this.content.isFormula = false
  213 |                 if (value === 'numeric') {
  214 |                     this.content.numeric = true
  215 |                 } else if (value === 'autocompletion') {
  216 |                     this.content.autocompletion = true
  217 |                 } else if (value === 'formula') {
  218 |                     this.content.isFormula = true
  219 |                 }
  220 |             },
  221 |         },
  222 |     },
  223 |     mounted() {
  224 |         console.log('contenido: ', this.content)
  225 |         if (!('autocompletion' in this.content)) {

  229 |         if (this.content.numeric) {
  230 |             this.variableType = 'numeric'
  231 |         } else if (this.content.autocompletion) {
  232 |             this.variableType = 'autocompletion'
  233 |         } else if (this.content.isFormula) {
  234 |             this.variableType = 'formula'
  235 |         } else {
  236 |             this.variableType = 'text'
  237 |         }
  238 |     },
  239 |     methods: {
  240 |         seeDecimals() {
  241 |             if (this.content.decimalLimit === '') {
  242 |                 this.content.decimalLimit = 0
  243 |             }
  244 |         },
  245 |         addAutocompletionItem() {
  246 |             const newItem = {text: 'Nueva autocompletación'}
  247 |             this.content.autocompletionList.push(newItem)
  248 |             this.autocompletionKey += 1
  249 |         },
  250 |         deleteAutocompletionItem(index) {
  251 |             this.content.autocompletionList.splice(index, 1)
  252 |             this.selectAutocompletion = null
  253 |             this.autocompletionKey += 1
  254 |         },
  255 |         ver() {
  256 |             console.log('lista: ', this.content.autocompletionList)
  257 |         },
  258 |         editAutocompletionItem(index) {
  259 |             this.selectAutocompletion = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(this.content.autocompletionList[index].text))
  260 |             this.indexAutocompletion = index
  261 |             this.activeAutocompletion = true
  262 |         },
  263 |         acceptAutocompletionItem() {
  264 |             this.content.autocompletionList[this.indexAutocompletion].text = this.selectAutocompletion
  265 |             this.activeAutocompletion = false
  266 |             this.selectAutocompletion = null
  267 |             this.autocompletionKey += 1
  268 |         },
  269 |         cancelAutocompletionItem() {
  270 |             this.activeAutocompletion = false
  271 |             this.selectAutocompletion = null
  272 |         },
  273 |     },
  274 | }
  275 | </script>

  232 | import waypayMixin from '@/mixins/services/waypayMixin'

  235 | import NewDollarDialog from '@/components/modules/admission/NewDollarDialog.vue'
  236 | import pacientsMixin from '@/mixins/services/pacientsMixin'
  237 | 
  238 | export default {
  239 |   name: 'AnnularPatientDialog',
  240 |   components: { NewDollarDialog },
  241 |   mixins: [ waypayMixin, TypePaymentMixin, pacientsMixin ],
  242 |   model: {
  243 |     prop: 'show',
  244 |     event: 'change-model',
  245 |   },
  246 |   props: {
  247 |     show: {
  248 |       type: Boolean,
  249 |       default: false,
  250 |     },
  251 |     selectedPatient: {
  252 |       type: Object,
  253 |       default: () => ({})
  254 |     },
  255 |   },
  256 |   data() {
  257 |     return {
  258 |       wayPayPatient: {},
  259 |       totalPay: 0,
  260 |       saldo: 0,
  261 |       wayPay: [],      
  262 |       noMorePayment: false,
  263 |       itemSelectFP: null,
  264 |       itemMontoFP: 0,
  265 |       itemLabel1: '',
  266 |       itemLabel2: '',
  267 |       itemMonto1: '',
  268 |       itemMonto2: '',
  269 |       typePayment: null,
  270 |       moreToPay: false,
  271 |       dollarValue: null,      
  272 |       newDollar: false,
  273 |       canDolares: false,
  274 |       canceledPatient: false,
  275 |       billPatient: false,
  276 |       currencyMask: createNumberMask({
  277 |           prefix: "",
  278 |           includeThousandsSeparator: false,
  279 |           allowNegative: false,
  280 |           allowDecimal: true,
  281 |           decimalLimit: 2,
  282 |       }),
  283 |       headers: [
  284 |       {text: 'Descripción', align: 'start', value: 'description'},
  285 |       {text: 'Data 1', align: 'start', value: 'description_1'},
  286 |       {text: 'Data 2', align: 'start', value: 'description_2'},
  287 |       {text: 'Monto', align: 'end', value: 'amount'},
  288 |       ],
  289 |     }
  290 |   },
  291 |   async mounted() {
  292 |     await this.searchWayPay()
  293 |     await this.startPayment()
  294 |     await this.typePaymentActive()
  295 |     this.getDollar()
  296 |   },
  297 |   methods: {
  298 |     async anular() {
  299 |       const clientId = localStorage.clientId
  300 |       const fechaActual = this.currentDate()
  301 |       const newwayPay = {
  302 |         id_users: clientId,
  303 |         id_patients: this.selectedPatient.id,
  304 |         id_client: this.selectedPatient.client_id,
  305 |         date: fechaActual,
  306 |         date_patients: fechaActual,
  307 |         annulment: true,
  308 |       }
  309 |       let result = await this.setwayPay(newwayPay)
  310 |       const wayPayId = result.id
  311 |       await this.asyncForEach(this.wayPay, async (item) => {
  312 |         item.id_way_pay = wayPayId
  313 |         result = await this.setWayPayItems(item)
  314 |       })
  315 |       const annulledPatient = {
  316 |         canceled: true,
  317 |         cancellation_date: (new Date(Date.now() - (new Date()).getTimezoneOffset() * 60000)).toISOString().substr(0, 10),
  318 |         user_id_canceled: clientId,
  319 |       }
  320 |       result = await this.updatePatient(this.selectedPatient.id, annulledPatient)
  321 |       this.canceledPatient = true
  322 |       if (result.invoice) {
  323 |         this.billPatient = true
  324 |       }
  325 |       this.$emit('canceled-patient')
  326 |     },
  327 |     async setWayPayItems(item) {
  328 |       const result = await this.setNewWayPay(item)
  329 |       return result
  330 |     },
  331 |     async searchWayPay() {
  332 |       const result = await this.getWaypayPatientId(this.selectedPatient.id)
  333 |       if (result) {
  334 |         if (result.waypayitems) {
  335 |           await this.asyncForEach(result.waypayitems, async (tipo) => {
  336 |             tipo.description_1 = tipo.description_1.replace('.', ',')
  337 |             tipo.amount = this.formatNumber(tipo.amount)
  338 |             tipo.description = await this.buscarDescripcion(tipo.id_type_payment)
  339 |           })
  340 |         }    
  341 |       }
  342 |       this.wayPayPatient = result
  343 |     },
  344 |     async buscarDescripcion(id) {
  345 |       const result = await this.getTypepaymentId(id)
  346 |       if (result) {
  347 |         return result.description
  348 |       }
  349 |       return ''
  350 |     },    
  351 |     async asyncForEach(array, callback) {
  352 |       for (let index = 0; index < array.length; index++) {
  353 |         await callback(array[index], index, array);
  354 |       }
  355 |     },   
  356 |     formatNumber(number) {
  357 |       return new Intl.NumberFormat('de-DE', { 
  358 |         minimumFractionDigits: 2, 
  359 |         maximumFractionDigits: 2 
  360 |       }).format(number);
  361 |     },
  362 |     startPayment() {
  363 |       if (this.selectedPatient.total_dollars !== 0) {
  364 |         this.totalPay = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(this.selectedPatient.total_dollars))
  365 |       } else {
  366 |         this.totalPay = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(this.selectedPatient.total))
  367 |       }    
  368 |       this.saldo = this.totalPay
  369 |     },
  370 |     putMoreToPay() {
  371 |       console.log('llego')
  372 |       if (this.moreToPay === false) {
  373 |         this.itemSelectFP = null
  374 |         this.itemMontoFP = 0
  375 |         this.itemLabel1 = ''
  376 |         this.itemLabel2 = ''
  377 |         this.itemMonto1 = ''
  378 |         this.itemMonto2 = ''
  379 |       }
  380 |       if (this.selectedPatient.total_dollars !== 0) {
  381 |         this.typePayment[0].disable = true
  382 |         this.typePayment[1].disable = false
  383 |       } else {
  384 |         this.typePayment[0].disable = false
  385 |         this.typePayment[1].disable = true
  386 |       }
  387 |       this.moreToPay = !this.moreToPay
  388 |     },    
  389 |     async typePaymentActive() {
  390 |       const payment =  await this.getTypePayment()
  391 |       var isDisa = false
  392 |       if (this.selectedPatient.total_dollars !== 0) isDisa = true
  393 |       payment.forEach((item) => {
  394 |         if (item.description === 'Efectivo-dólares') {
  395 |           if (isDisa) {
  396 |             item.disable = false
  397 |           } else {
  398 |             item.disable = true
  399 |           }
  400 |         }
  401 |         if (item.description === 'Efectivo') {
  402 |           if (isDisa) {
  403 |             item.disable = true
  404 |           } else {
  405 |             item.disable = false
  406 |           }
  407 |         }
  408 |       })
  409 |       this.typePayment = payment
  410 |     },    
  411 |     changePaymentMethod() {
  412 |       this.itemMonto1 = ''
  413 |       this.itemMonto2 = ''
  414 |       const item = this.typePayment.find(objet => objet.id === this.itemSelectFP)
  415 |       this.itemLabel1 = item.description_1
  416 |       this.itemLabel2 = item.description_2
  417 |       if (this.itemSelectFP === 2) {
  418 |         this.itemMonto1 = '$ ' + this.dollarValue.value
  419 |         this.itemMonto2 = this.dollarValue.date
  420 |       }
  421 |     },    
  422 |     async activeNewDollar(dolar) {
  423 |       this.newDollar = false
  424 |       if (dolar !== '') {
  425 |         dolar = dolar.toString()
  426 |         dolar = dolar.replace('.', '')
  427 |         dolar = dolar.replace(',', '.')
  428 |         if (isNaN(dolar) === false) {
  429 |           const newValue = { value: dolar, }
  430 |           const result = await this.setNewDolar(newValue)
  431 |           if (result) {
  432 |             this.getDollar()
  433 |           }
  434 |         }
  435 |       }
  436 |       this.getDollar()
  437 |     },
  438 |     currentDate() {
  439 |       const fecha = new Date()
  440 |       const anio = fecha.getFullYear()
  441 |       var mes = fecha.getMonth() + 1
  442 |       var dia = fecha.getDate()
  443 |       if (mes < 10) {
  444 |           mes = "0" + mes
  445 |       }
  446 |       if (dia < 10) {
  447 |           dia = "0" + dia
  448 |       }
  449 |       const fechaActual = anio + "-" + mes + "-" + dia
  450 |       return fechaActual
  451 |     },
  452 |     async getDollar() {
  453 |       this.dollarValue = await this.getDollarValue()
  454 |       const date = this.dollarValue.date
  455 |       this.dollarValue.date = date.split('T')[0]
  456 |     },
  457 |     registerPaymentMethod() {
  458 |       var monto = this.itemMontoFP
  459 |       const newItem = {
  460 |         'id_type_payment': this.itemSelectFP,
  461 |         'description_1': this.itemMonto1,
  462 |         'description_2': this.itemMonto2,
  463 |         'amount': monto,
  464 |         'dollar': this.canDolares ? 1 : 0,
  465 |         'dollar_value': this.canDolares ? this.dollarValue.value : 0,
  466 |         'dollar_date': this.canDolares ? this.dollarValue.date : null,
  467 |       }
  468 |       this.wayPay.push(newItem)
  469 |       this.saldo -= monto
  470 |       this.moreToPay = false      
  471 |     },
  472 |     placeDescription(id) {
  473 |       const item = this.typePayment.find(objet => objet.id === id)
  474 |       return item.description
  475 |     },
  476 |     async deleteItem(item) {
  477 |       const tsaldo = Number(item.amount)
  478 |       this.wayPay = this.wayPay.filter(objeto => objeto.id_type_payment !== item.id_type_payment)
  479 |       this.saldo += tsaldo
  480 |     },
  481 |   },
  482 | 
  483 | }
  484 | </script>

   91 |       const filter = {

   96 |       if (result) {

  183 | <script>
  184 | import antibioticMixin from '@/mixins/services/antibioticMixin.js'
  185 | 
  186 | export default {
  187 |     name: 'Antibiograma',
  188 |     mixins: [antibioticMixin],
  189 |     props: {
  190 |         cultivo: {
  191 |             type: Object,
  192 |             default: () => ({})
  193 |         },
  194 |     },
  195 |     data() {
  196 |         return {
  197 |             antibiotic: null,
  198 |             listGerms: [],
  199 |         }
  200 |     },
  201 |     async mounted() {
  202 |         const result = await this.getAntibioticListsOrder()
  203 |         if (result) {
  204 |             this.antibiotic = result
  205 |         }
  206 |         const resultG = await this.getListGermsOrder()
  207 |         if (resultG) {
  208 |             this.listGerms = resultG.map(objeto => ({ name: objeto.germen.trim() }))
  209 |         }
  210 |     },
  211 |     methods: {
  212 |         agregar(type, index) {
  213 |             const newItem = {
  214 |                 antibiotic: '',
  215 |                 mic: '',
  216 |             }
  217 |             if (type === 'sensible') {
  218 |                 this.cultivo.resultado[index].antibiograma.sensible.push(newItem)
  219 |             } else if (type === 'intermedio') {
  220 |                 this.cultivo.resultado[index].antibiograma.intermedio.push(newItem)
  221 |             } else if (type === 'resistente') {
  222 |                 this.cultivo.resultado[index].antibiograma.resistente.push(newItem)
  223 |             }
  224 |         },
  225 |         eliminar(type, index, i) {
  226 |             if (type === 'sensible') {
  227 |                 this.cultivo.resultado[index].antibiograma.sensible.splice(i, 1)
  228 |             } else if (type === 'intermedio') {
  229 |                 this.cultivo.resultado[index].antibiograma.intermedio.splice(i, 1)
  230 |             } else if (type === 'resistente') {
  231 |                 this.cultivo.resultado[index].antibiograma.resistente.splice(i, 1)
  232 |             }
  233 |         },
  234 |         agregarOrganismo() {
  235 |             const newItem = {
  236 |                 organismo: '',
  237 |                 antibiograma: {
  238 |                     sensible: [],
  239 |                     intermedio: [],
  240 |                     resistente: [],
  241 |                 },
  242 |             }
  243 |             this.cultivo.resultado.push(newItem)
  244 |         },
  245 |         eliminarOrganismo(index) {
  246 |             this.cultivo.resultado.splice(index, 1)
  247 |         },
  248 |     },
  249 | }
  250 | </script>

    7 | <script>
    8 |     import pacientsMixin from '@/mixins/services/pacientsMixin'
    9 |     import laboratoryMixin from '@/mixins/services/laboratoryMixin'
   10 |     import usersMixin from '@/mixins/services/usersMixin'
   11 |     import { basePath } from '@/config';
   12 |     
   13 |     export default {
   14 |         name: 'ReportPatient',
   15 |         mixins: [pacientsMixin, laboratoryMixin, usersMixin],
   16 |         props: {
   17 |             id: {
   18 |                 type: Number,
   19 |                 default: 0,
   20 |             },
   21 |             isPrint: {
   22 |                 type: Boolean,
   23 |                 default: true
   24 |             }
   25 |         },
   26 |         data() {
   27 |             return {
   28 |                 basePath,
   29 |                 printHidden: true,
   30 |                 selectedPatient: null,
   31 |                 headHtml: null,
   32 |                 contentTot: '',
   33 |                 maximumRowsReport: 34,
   34 |             }
   35 |         },
   36 |         async mounted() {
   37 |             this.getPatient()  
   38 |         },
   39 |         methods: {
   40 |             async getPatient() {
   41 |                 const result = await this.getPatientIdValidatedResult(this.id)
   42 |                 if (result) {
   43 |                     this.selectedPatient = result 
   44 |                     await this.getLaboratory()
   45 |                     await this.colocaResult()
   46 |                     await this.imprimir()
   47 |                 } else {
   48 |                     this.$toast.warning('Los exámenes reportados deben haber sido aprobados.')
   49 |                     return
   50 |                 }
   51 |             },
   52 |             async getLaboratory() {
   53 |                 const result = await this.getLaboratorySetting()
   54 |                 if (result) {
   55 |                     this.headHtml = result.head_html
   56 |                     this.maximumRowsReport = result.maximum_rows_report
   57 |                 }
   58 |                 if (this.headHtml) {
   59 |                     this.headHtml = this.headHtml.replace('[Label_Laboratorio]', result.business_name)
   60 |                     let domicilio = `${result.address}<br>Teléfonos: ${result.phone_1}`
   61 |                     if (result.phone_2 !== '') {
   62 |                         domicilio += '  --  '+ result.phone_2
   63 |                     }
   64 |                     domicilio += `<br>Correo: ${result.email}`
   65 |                     if (result.url !== '') {
   66 |                         domicilio += `<br>${result.url}`
   67 |                     }
   68 |                     this.headHtml = this.headHtml.replace('[logo]',`${this.basePath}/images/${result.logo}`)
   69 |                     this.headHtml = this.headHtml.replace('[Label_Laboratorio]', result.business_name)
   70 |                     this.headHtml = this.headHtml.replace('[Label_domicilio]', domicilio)
   71 |                     this.headHtml = this.headHtml.replace('[NoPaciente]', this.selectedPatient.patient_position)
   72 |                     this.headHtml = this.headHtml.replace('[Nombre]', this.selectedPatient.name)
   73 |                     this.headHtml = this.headHtml.replace('[Edad]', this.selectedPatient.age + ' ' + this.selectedPatient.month_year)
   74 |                     this.headHtml = this.headHtml.replace('[CI]', this.selectedPatient.document_number)
   75 |                     this.headHtml = this.headHtml.replace('[Fecha]', this.selectedPatient.admission_date)
   76 |                     var alto = '680px'
   77 |                     if (this.isPrint) alto = '1000px'
   78 |                     this.headHtml = this.headHtml.replace(/\[alto_body\]/g, alto)  
   79 |                 }
   80 |             },
   81 |             async colocaResult() {
   82 |                 var approvedId = -1
   83 |                 var content = ''
   84 |                 var resultsContent = ''
   85 |                 var totalRow = parseInt(this.maximumRowsReport, 10)
   86 |                 await this.asyncForEach(this.selectedPatient.exams, async (item) => {
   87 |                     if (approvedId === -1) {
   88 |                         approvedId = item.approved_id
   89 |                         content += this.headHtml
   90 |                         var user = await this.getUserById(item.approved_id)
   91 |                         if (user.status === 404) {
   92 |                             content = content.replace('[Label_bionalista]', '')
   93 |                             content = content.replace(`<img src='[firma]' style='max-height:18mm; max-width:36mm;' />`, ``)
   94 |                         } else {
   95 |                             content = content.replace('[Label_bionalista]', `${user.name}<br>${user.college_number}`)
   96 |                             content = content.replace('[firma]', `${this.basePath}/images/${user.url_signature}`)
   97 |                         }
   98 |                     }
   99 |                     if (approvedId === item.approved_id) {
  100 |                         if ((totalRow - item.size) < 1) {
  101 |                             content = content.replace('[body]', resultsContent)
  102 |                             content += `<div style="page-break-after: always;"></div>`
  103 |                             content += this.headHtml
  104 |                             var user = await this.getUserById(item.approved_id)
  105 |                             if (user.status === 404) {
  106 |                                 content = content.replace('[Label_bionalista]', '')
  107 |                                 content = content.replace(`<img src='[firma]' style='max-height:18mm; max-width:36mm;' />`, ``)
  108 |                             } else {
  109 |                                 content = content.replace('[Label_bionalista]', `${user.name}<br>${user.college_number}`)
  110 |                                 content = content.replace('[firma]', `${this.basePath}/images/${user.url_signature}`)
  111 |                             }
  112 |                             resultsContent = ''
  113 |                             totalRow = parseInt(this.maximumRowsReport, 10)
  114 |                         }
  115 |                         if (this.isPrint) {
  116 |                             item.result = item.result.replace(/<p>/g, '<p style="font-size: 14px;">')
  117 |                         } else {
  118 |                             item.result = item.result.replace(/<p>/g, '<p style="font-size: 10px;">')
  119 |                         }
  120 |                         resultsContent += item.result
  121 |                         totalRow = totalRow - parseInt(item.size, 10)
  122 |                     } else {
  123 |                         content = content.replace('[body]', resultsContent)
  124 |                         content += this.headHtml
  125 |                         var user = await this.getUserById(item.approved_id)
  126 |                         if (user.status === 404) {
  127 |                             content = content.replace('[Label_bionalista]', '')
  128 |                             content = content.replace(`<img src='[firma]' style='max-height:18mm; max-width:36mm;' />`, ``)
  129 |                         } else {
  130 |                             content = content.replace('[Label_bionalista]', `${user.name}<br>${user.college_number}`)
  131 |                             content = content.replace('[firma]', `${this.basePath}/images/${user.url_signature}`)
  132 |                         }
  133 |                         resultsContent = ''
  134 |                         approvedId = item.approved_id
  135 |                         totalRow = parseInt(this.maximumRowsReport, 10)
  136 |                     }
  137 |                 })
  138 |                 if (resultsContent !== '') {
  139 |                     content = content.replace('[body]', resultsContent)
  140 |                 }
  141 |                 if (this.isPrint) {
  142 |                     content = content.replace(/font-size: 10px;/g, 'font-size: 14px;')
  143 |                 }
  144 |                 this.contentTot = await content
  145 |             },
  146 |             async asyncForEach(array, callback) {
  147 |                 for (let index = 0; index < array.length; index++) {
  148 |                     await callback(array[index], index, array);
  149 |                 }
  150 |             },
  151 |             async imprimir() {
  152 |                 if (this.isPrint) {
  153 |                     this.printHidden = false
  154 |                     this.$htmlToPaper('printV')
  155 |                 } else {
  156 |                     this.contentTot = `<div style="padding: 20px;background: white;">${this.contentTot}</div>`
  157 |                     this.$emit('return-html', this.contentTot)
  158 |                 }
  159 |             }, 
  160 |         },
  161 |     }
  162 | </script>

   58 |   },

   72 |     await this.getItems()

  117 |     },

  151 |           detalle += newLinea

  153 |         const numberDescriptions = listItem.list.length

  176 |         tipoFactura = tipoFactura.replace('[razon-social]', this.client.business_name)
  177 |         tipoFactura = tipoFactura.replace('[rif]', this.client.rif)
  178 |         tipoFactura = tipoFactura.replace('[domicilio]', this.client.address)
  179 |         tipoFactura = tipoFactura.replace('[name]', `--Varios--`)
  180 |         tipoFactura = tipoFactura.replace('[phone]', this.client.phone)
  181 |         var textFoot = ''
  182 |         var ini = 0
  183 |         await this.asyncForEach(listItem.footer, async (item) => {
  184 |           if (item.active) {
  185 |             textFoot += `<tr>
  186 |               <td colspan="3" style="padding: 5px 10px; text-align: right;">
  187 |                   ${item.description}`
  188 |               if (item.value !== null) {
  189 |                   textFoot += ` ${this.formatNumber(item.value) }`
  190 |               }
  191 |               if (ini > 1 && ini !== this.footPayments.length - 1) {
  192 |                 textFoot += ` %`
  193 |               }
  194 |               if (item.sobre !== null) {
  195 |                   textFoot += ` SOBRE ${this.formatNumber(parseFloat(item.sobre))}`
  196 |               }
  197 |               textFoot += `</td>
  198 |               <td style="padding: 5px 10px; border-bottom: 2px solid black; border-right: 2px solid black; border-left: 2px solid black; text-align: right;">
  199 |                   ${this.formatNumber(parseFloat(item.total))}
  200 |               </td>
  201 |             </tr>`
  202 |           }
  203 |           ini += 1
  204 |         })
  205 |         tipoFactura = tipoFactura.replace('[totales]', textFoot)
  206 |         tipoFactura = tipoFactura.replace('[noInvoice]', 'XXXX')
  207 |         listItem.invoice = tipoFactura  
  208 |       })
  209 |       this.placeInvoices()
  210 |     },
  211 |     async placeInvoices() {
  212 |       var parrafo = ''
  213 |       await this.asyncForEach(this.listItems, async (listItem) => {   
  214 |         parrafo += listItem.invoice
  215 |         parrafo += `<div style="page-break-after: always;"></div>`
  216 |       })
  217 |       this.miDiv = parrafo
  218 |     },
  219 |     async recordReceivables() {
  220 |       await this.asyncForEach(this.listItems, async (listItem) => {
  221 |         const result = await this.getIncreaseInvoice()
  222 |         const noInvoice = parseInt(result.invoice_number) + 1
  223 |         listItem.noInvoice = noInvoice
  224 |         listItem.invoice = await listItem.invoice.replace(/XXXX/g, noInvoice.toString() )
  225 |         const change = {
  226 |           invoice_number: noInvoice,
  227 |         }
  228 |         await this.increaseInvoice(change)
  229 |         const idInvoice = await this.registerInvoice(noInvoice, listItem.footer)
  230 |         await this.registerInvoiceItems(idInvoice, listItem.list )
  231 |       })
  232 |       this.miDiv = ''
  233 |       await this.rePrintInvoice()
  234 |       await this.$htmlToPaper("printV")
  235 |       this.endRegisterInvoice()
  236 |     },
  237 |     async rePrintInvoice() {
  238 |       let parrafo = ''
  239 |       await this.asyncForEach(this.listItems, async (listItem) => {
  240 |         parrafo += listItem.invoice
  241 |         parrafo += `<div style="page-break-after: always;"></div>`
  242 |       })
  243 |       this.miDiv = parrafo
  244 |     },
  245 |     async registerInvoice(NoFact, items) {
  246 |       const total = parseFloat(items[items.length-1].total)
  247 |       const newInvoice = {
  248 |         no_invoice: NoFact,
  249 |         id_patients: 0,
  250 |         business_name: this.client.business_name,
  251 |         document_type: 'Factura',
  252 |         rif: this.client.rif,
  253 |         address: this.client.address,
  254 |         id_users: localStorage.clientId,
  255 |         subtotal: 0,
  256 |         discount: this.discount,
  257 |         discount_total: 0,
  258 |         iva: 0,
  259 |         iva_total: 0,
  260 |         tax_base: 0,
  261 |         total: total,
  262 |         paying: 0,
  263 |         foot_payments: items,
  264 |         id_client: this.clientSelection,
  265 |       }
  266 |       var result = await this.insertNewInvoice(newInvoice)
  267 |       return result.id
  268 |     },
  269 |     async registerInvoiceItems(invoiceId, list ) {
  270 |       await this.asyncForEach(list, async (item) => {
  271 |         const newInvoiceItem = {
  272 |           id_invoice: invoiceId,
  273 |           id_exams: item.exam_id,
  274 |           quantity: item.amount,
  275 |           description: item.description,
  276 |           amount: item.total / item.amount,
  277 |           total: item.total,
  278 |         }
  279 |         await this.insertNewInvoiceItem(newInvoiceItem)
  280 |       })
  281 |     },
  282 |     async endRegisterInvoice() {
  283 |       let listFact = ''
  284 |       let total = 0
  285 |       await this.asyncForEach(this.listItems, async (listItem) => {
  286 |         total += parseFloat(listItem.footer[listItem.footer.length-1].total)
  287 |         if (listFact.length !== 0) listFact += ', '
  288 |         listFact += listItem.noInvoice.toString()
  289 |       })
  290 |       const newCustomerAccounts = {
  291 |         client_id: this.clientSelection,
  292 |         invoice: listFact,
  293 |         total: total,
  294 |         total_dollars: this.chargeDollars ? total / this.dollarValue.value : 0,
  295 |       }
  296 |       const result = await this.createAccountsReceivable(newCustomerAccounts)
  297 |       if (result) {
  298 |         this.$emit('record-receivables', listFact)
  299 |       }
  300 |     },
  301 |   },
  302 | }
  303 | </script>

   92 |                   </td>

   95 |                   </td>

   98 |                   </td>

   73 |                     <td class="text-right info--text">{{ formatNumber(saldo) }}</td>
   74 |                   </tr>

   76 |               </template>
   77 |             </v-simple-table>
   78 |             <v-btn
   79 |               color="primary"
   80 |               class="mt-2"
   81 |               :disabled="noMorePayment"
   82 |               @click="putMoreToPay()">
   83 |               <v-icon left>mdi-cash-sync</v-icon>
   84 |               Registra forma de pago
   85 |             </v-btn>
   86 |             <v-card v-if="moreToPay" class="mt-2" style="border: 1px solid gray">
   87 |               <v-card-text class="mb-6">
   88 |                 <v-row>
   89 |                   <v-col cols="4">
   90 |                     <v-select
   91 |                       v-model="itemSelectFP"
   92 |                       :items="typePayment"
   93 |                       item-disabled="disable"
   94 |                       label="Forma de pago"
   95 |                       item-text="description"
   96 |                       item-value="id"
   97 |                       dense
   98 |                       outlined
   99 |                       hide-details
  100 |                       @change="changePaymentMethod()"
  101 |                     />
  102 |                   </v-col>
  103 |                   <v-col cols="2">
  104 |                     <v-text-field
  105 |                       v-if="itemLabel1 !== ''"
  106 |                       v-model="itemMonto1"

  108 |                       outlined

  110 |                       dense
  111 |                     />
  112 |                   </v-col>

  114 |                     <v-text-field
  115 |                       v-if="itemLabel2 !== ''"
  116 |                       v-model="itemMonto2"
  117 |                       :label="itemLabel2"
  118 |                       outlined

  120 |                       dense
  121 |                     />
  122 |                   </v-col>

  124 |                     <v-text-field
  125 |                       v-model="itemMontoFP"

  138 |                   outlined
  139 |                   color="secondary"
  140 |                   class="mt-2"
  141 |                   @click="registerPaymentMethod()"
  142 |                 >
  143 |                   Registra forma de pago
  144 |                 </v-btn>

  159 |           </v-btn>

  161 |             color="primary"
  162 |             text
  163 |             :disabled="!noMorePayment"
  164 |             @click="sendPaymentMethod()"

  173 | <script>
  174 | import functionMixin from '@/mixins/util/functionMixin'
  175 | import createNumberMask from 'text-mask-addons/dist/createNumberMask'
  176 | import waypayMixin from '@/mixins/services/waypayMixin'
  177 | import examsListMixin from '@/mixins/services/examsListMixin'
  178 | export default {
  179 |   name: 'TypePaymentDialog',
  180 |   mixins: [functionMixin, waypayMixin, examsListMixin],
  181 |   model: {
  182 |     prop: 'show',
  183 |     event: 'change-model',
  184 |   },
  185 |   props: {
  186 |     show: {
  187 |       type: Boolean,
  188 |       default: false,
  189 |     },
  190 |     wayPayTmp: {
  191 |       type: Array,
  192 |       default: () => [],
  193 |     },
  194 |     totalCancelTmp: {
  195 |       type: Number,
  196 |       default: 0,
  197 |     },
  198 |     cancelDollars: {
  199 |       type: Boolean,
  200 |       default: false,
  201 |     }
  202 |   },
  203 |   data() {
  204 |     return {
  205 |       wayPay: this.wayPayTmp,
  206 |       totalCancel: this.totalCancelTmp, 
  207 |       currencyMask: createNumberMask({
  208 |         prefix: "",
  209 |         includeThousandsSeparator: false,
  210 |         allowNegative: false,
  211 |         allowDecimal: true,
  212 |         decimalLimit: 2,
  213 |       }),
  214 |       dollarValue: null,      
  215 |       totalPay: 0,
  216 |       saldo: 0,
  217 |       moreToPay: false,
  218 |       itemSelectFP: null,
  219 |       itemMontoFP: 0,
  220 |       itemLabel1: '',
  221 |       itemLabel2: '',
  222 |       itemMonto1: '',
  223 |       itemMonto2: '',
  224 |       typePayment: null,
  225 |       noMorePayment: false,
  226 |     }
  227 |   },
  228 |   watch: {
  229 |     'saldo': {
  230 |       handler(value) {
  231 |         if (value <= 0) {
  232 |           this.noMorePayment = true
  233 |         } else {
  234 |           this.noMorePayment = false
  235 |         }
  236 |       },
  237 |     },
  238 |   },
  239 |   async mounted() {
  240 |     await this.getDollar()
  241 |     await this.typePaymentActive()
  242 |     this.startPayment()
  243 |   },
  244 |   methods: {
  245 |     startPayment() {
  246 |       if (this.cancelDollars) {
  247 |         this.totalPay = this.calculateDollars()
  248 |       } else {
  249 |         this.totalPay = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(this.totalCancel))
  250 |       }    
  251 |       this.saldo = this.totalPay
  252 |     },
  253 |     sendPaymentMethod() {
  254 |       const newWayPay = {
  255 |         wayPay: this.wayPay,
  256 |         total: this.totalPay,
  257 |       }
  258 |       this.$emit('accept-cancellation', newWayPay)
  259 |     },
  260 |     async getDollar() {
  261 |       const result = await this.getDollarValue()
  262 |       if (result) {
  263 |         this.dollarValue = result
  264 |         const date = this.dollarValue.date
  265 |         this.dollarValue.date = date.split('T')[0]
  266 |         this.dollarValue.value = parseFloat(this.dollarValue.value)
  267 |       }
  268 |     },
  269 |     async typePaymentActive() {
  270 |       const payment =  await this.getTypePayment()
  271 |       var isDisa = false
  272 |       if (this.cancelDollars) isDisa = true
  273 |       payment.forEach((item) => {
  274 |         if (item.description === 'Efectivo-dólares') {
  275 |           if (isDisa) {
  276 |             item.disable = false
  277 |           } else {
  278 |             item.disable = true
  279 |           }
  280 |         }
  281 |         if (item.description === 'Efectivo') {
  282 |           if (isDisa) {
  283 |             item.disable = true
  284 |           } else {
  285 |             item.disable = false
  286 |           }
  287 |         }
  288 |       })
  289 |       this.typePayment = payment
  290 |     },
  291 |     calculateDollars() {
  292 |       if (this.dollarValue.value) {
  293 |         const total = Math.round(this.totalCancel / this.dollarValue.value)
  294 |         return total
  295 |       }
  296 |       return 0
  297 |     },
  298 |     async deleteItem(item) {
  299 |       const tsaldo = Number(item.amount)
  300 |       this.wayPay = this.wayPay.filter((nodo) => nodo.id_type_payment !== item.id_type_payment)
  301 |       this.saldo += tsaldo
  302 |     },
  303 |     putMoreToPay() {
  304 |       if (this.moreToPay === false) {
  305 |         this.itemSelectFP = null
  306 |         this.itemMontoFP = 0
  307 |         this.itemLabel1 = ''
  308 |         this.itemLabel2 = ''
  309 |         this.itemMonto1 = ''
  310 |         this.itemMonto2 = ''
  311 |       }
  312 |       if (this.dollarValue) {
  313 |         this.typePayment[0].disable = true
  314 |         this.typePayment[1].disable = false
  315 |       } else {
  316 |         this.typePayment[0].disable = false
  317 |         this.typePayment[1].disable = true
  318 |       }
  319 |       this.moreToPay = !this.moreToPay
  320 |     },
  321 |     changePaymentMethod() {
  322 |       this.itemMonto1 = ''
  323 |       this.itemMonto2 = ''
  324 |       const item = this.typePayment.find(objet => objet.id === this.itemSelectFP)
  325 |       this.itemLabel1 = item.description_1
  326 |       this.itemLabel2 = item.description_2
  327 |       if (this.itemSelectFP === 2) {
  328 |         this.itemMonto1 = '$ ' + this.dollarValue.value
  329 |         this.itemMonto2 = this.dollarValue.date
  330 |       }
  331 |     },    
  332 |     registerPaymentMethod() {
  333 |       var monto = this.itemMontoFP
  334 |       const newItem = {
  335 |         'id_type_payment': this.itemSelectFP,
  336 |         'description_1': this.itemMonto1,
  337 |         'description_2': this.itemMonto2,
  338 |         'amount': monto,
  339 |         'dollar': this.canDolares ? 1 : 0,
  340 |         'dollar_value': this.canDolares ? this.dollarValue.value : 0,
  341 |         'dollar_date': this.canDolares ? this.dollarValue.date : null,
  342 |       }
  343 |       this.wayPay.push(newItem)
  344 |       this.saldo -= monto
  345 |       this.totalCancel = this.totalPay - this.saldo
  346 |       this.moreToPay = false      
  347 |     },
  348 |     placeDescription(id) {
  349 |       const item = this.typePayment.find(objet => objet.id === id)
  350 |       return item.description
  351 |     },
  352 |   },
  353 | }
  354 | </script>

  268 | <script>
  269 | import createNumberMask from 'text-mask-addons/dist/createNumberMask'
  270 | import laboratoryMixin from '@/mixins/services/laboratoryMixin'
  271 | import { basePath } from '@/config';
  272 | 
  273 | export default {
  274 |     name: 'BillingLaboratory',
  275 |     mixins: [laboratoryMixin],
  276 |     props: {
  277 |         dataLaboratory: {
  278 |             type: Object,
  279 |             default: () => ({})
  280 |         },
  281 |         dataTax: {
  282 |             type: Array,
  283 |             default: () => [],
  284 |         },
  285 |         valid: {
  286 |             type: Boolean,
  287 |             default: false,
  288 |         },
  289 |     },
  290 |     data() {
  291 |         return {
  292 |             basePath,
  293 |             currencyMask: createNumberMask({
  294 |                 prefix: "",
  295 |                 includeThousandsSeparator: false,
  296 |                 allowNegative: false,
  297 |                 allowDecimal: true,
  298 |                 decimalLimit: 2,
  299 |             }),
  300 |             receiptModel: '',
  301 |         }
  302 |     },
  303 |     mounted() {
  304 |         let receipt = this.dataLaboratory.receipt_format
  305 |         receipt = receipt.replace('[business_name]', this.dataLaboratory.business_name)
  306 |         receipt = receipt.replace('[rif_lab]', this.dataLaboratory.rif)
  307 |         receipt = receipt.replace('[address_lab]', this.dataLaboratory.address)
  308 |         receipt = receipt.replace('[phone_1]', this.dataLaboratory.phone_1)
  309 |         receipt = receipt.replace('[phone_2]', this.dataLaboratory.phone_2)
  310 |         receipt = receipt.replace('[email]', this.dataLaboratory.email)
  311 |         receipt = receipt.replace('[src_image]', `${this.basePath}/images/${this.dataLaboratory.logo}` )
  312 |         this.receiptModel = receipt
  313 |     },
  314 |     methods: {
  315 |         change(type) {
  316 |             if (type === 'nDescrip') {
  317 |                 if(this.dataLaboratory.rows_description_invoices === '') {
  318 |                     this.dataLaboratory.rows_description_invoices = 5
  319 |                 }
  320 |             } else if (type === 'nInvoice') {
  321 |                 if(dataLaboratory.invoice_number === '') {
  322 |                     this.dataLaboratory.invoice_number = 0
  323 |                 }
  324 |             } else if (type === 'nVoucher') {
  325 |                 if(dataLaboratory.voucher_number === '') {
  326 |                     this.dataLaboratory.voucher_number = 0
  327 |                 }
  328 |             }

  183 | <script>
  184 | import VueQr from 'vue-qr'
  185 | 
  186 | export default {
  187 |     name: 'GeneralLaboratory',
  188 |     components: {
  189 |         VueQr
  190 |     },
  191 |     props: {
  192 |         dataLaboratory: {
  193 |             type: Object,
  194 |             default: () => ({})
  195 |         },
  196 |     },
  197 |     data() {
  198 |         return {
  199 |             marker: true,
  200 |             vCardData: '',
  201 |             settingQR: null,
  202 |             personalData: {
  203 |                 fn: 'Laboratorio Toro',
  204 |                 email: 'correo@example.com',
  205 |                 phone: '+56984550830',
  206 |                 bioanalista: 'Ana Rosa',
  207 |                 codigo: '22-55555-89',
  208 |             },        
  209 |             rulesBlank: [
  210 |                 v => !!v || 'Información es requerido',
  211 |             ],
  212 |             rulesEmail: [
  213 |                 v => !!v || 'E-mail es requerido',
  214 |                 v => /^(([^<>()[\]\\.,;:\s@']+(\.[^<>()\\[\]\\.,;:\s@']+)*)|('.+'))@((\[[0-9]{1,3}\.[0-9]{1,3}\.[0-9]{1,3}\.[0-9]{1,3}\])|(([a-zA-Z\-0-9]+\.)+[a-zA-Z]{2,}))$/.test(v) || 'El email debe ser válido',
  215 |             ],
  216 |         }
  217 |     },
  218 |     computed: {
  219 |         generatevCardData() {
  220 |             const telefono = this.settingQR.phone.replace(new RegExp(' ', 'g'), '')
  221 |             let datosQR = `BEGIN:VCARD\nVERSION:3.0\nFN:${this.settingQR.fn}\nORG:${this.settingQR.fn}\nTEL:${telefono}\nEMAIL:${this.settingQR.email}`
  222 |             if (this.settingQR.bioanalista !== '') {
  223 |                 datosQR += `\nBIOANALISTA:${this.settingQR.bioanalista}\nCODIGO:${this.settingQR.codigo}`
  224 |             }
  225 |             datosQR += `\nEND:VCARD`
  226 |             return datosQR
  227 |         },
  228 |     },
  229 |     async mounted() {
  230 |         this.settingQR = await this.dataLaboratory.settingQR
  231 |         if (this.settingQR) {
  232 |             if (this.settingQR.fn === '') this.settingQR.fn = this.dataLaboratory.name
  233 |             if (this.settingQR.phone === '') this.settingQR.phone = this.dataLaboratory.phone_1
  234 |             if (this.settingQR.email === '') this.settingQR.email = this.dataLaboratory.email
  235 |         }
  236 |     },
  237 |     methods: {
  238 |         clearMessage (type) {
  239 |             if (type === 'bioanalista') this.settingQR.bioanalista = ''
  240 |             if (type === 'codigo') this.settingQR.codigo = ''
  241 |         },
  242 |     },
  243 | }
  244 | </script>

  244 | <script>

  247 |   import { basePath } from '@/config';
  248 | 
  249 |   export default {
  250 |     name: 'UserEdit',

  256 |       },
  257 |     },

  260 |         basePath,
  261 |         itemEdit: this.itemEditTmp,
  262 |         valid: false,
  263 |         roles: [],
  264 |         listRoles: [
  265 |           'admin',
  266 |           'annular',
  267 |           'user',
  268 |         ],
  269 |         nameRules: [
  270 |           v => !!v || 'Nombre es requerido',

  273 |         nameUserRules: [

  277 |         rulesEmail: [
