  280 |         ],
  281 |         rulesDirection: [
  282 |           v => !!v || 'Dirección es requerido',
  283 |           v => (v && v.length <= 100) || 'debe tener menos de 100 caracteres.',
  284 |         ],
  285 |         rulesPosition: [
  286 |         v => !!v || 'Cargo es requerido',
  287 |           v => (v && v.length <= 50) || 'debe tener menos de 50 caracteres.',
  288 |         ],
  289 |         passwordRules: [
  290 |           v => !!v || 'La contraseña es obligatoria',
  291 |           v => (v && v.length >= 6) || 'La contraseña debe tener al menos 6 caracteres',
  292 |         ],
  293 |         
  294 |         claveRules: [
  295 |           v => !!v || 'La clave es obligatoria',
  296 |           v => (v && v.length >= 6) || 'La clave debe tener al menos 6 caracteres',
  297 |         ],
  298 |         confirmPasswordRules: [
  299 |           v => !!v || 'Debes confirmar tu contraseña',
  300 |           v => (v === this.password) || 'Las contraseñas no coinciden',
  301 |         ],
  302 |         confirmSignatureules: [
  303 |           v => !!v || 'Debes confirmar tu clave de firma',
  304 |           v => (v === this.claveSignature) || 'Las claves no coinciden',
  305 |         ],
  306 |         maskPhone: '+58 #### ### ####',        
  307 |         imgUser: null,       
  308 |         imgSignature: null,
  309 |         formData: null,
  310 |         formDataSignature: null,
  311 |         selectedFile: '',
  312 |         selectedFileSignature: '',
  313 |         password: "[REDACTED]",
  314 |         confirmPassword: '',
  315 |         claveSignature: '',
  316 |         confirmSignature: '',
  317 |         changePassword: false,
  318 |         changeSignature: false,
  319 |         type: '',
  320 |       }
  321 |     },
  322 |     watch: {
  323 |       'roles': {
  324 |         handler(value) {
  325 |           this.itemEdit.roles = ''
  326 |           if (value.length !== 0) {
  327 |             value.forEach(element => {
  328 |               if (this.itemEdit.roles.length !== 0) this.itemEdit.roles += ','
  329 |               this.itemEdit.roles += element
  330 |             })
  331 |           }
  332 |         }
  333 |       },
  334 |     },

  337 |       this.putData()
  338 |       this.$refs.form.validate()

  343 |         if (result) {

  345 |         }
  346 |       },
  347 |       putData() {
  348 |         if (this.itemEdit.roles.length !== 0) {
  349 |           this.roles = this.itemEdit.roles
  350 |         }
  351 |         if (this.itemEdit.id === -1) {          
  352 |           this.changePassword = true
  353 |         }
  354 |         this.imgUser = `${this.basePath}/images/${this.itemEdit.url_photo}`
  355 |         this.imgSignature = `${this.basePath}/images/${this.itemEdit.url_signature}`
  356 |       },
  357 |       onFileChange(e) {
  358 |         if (this.type === 'icon') {
  359 |           this.selectedFile = e.target.files[0];
  360 |           this.imgUser = URL.createObjectURL(this.selectedFile)
  361 |         } else {
  362 |           this.selectedFileSignature = e.target.files[0];
  363 |           this.imgSignature = URL.createObjectURL(this.selectedFileSignature)
  364 |         }
  365 |       },
  366 |       changeImg(type) {
  367 |         this.type = type
  368 |         if (type === 'icon') {
  369 |           this.$refs.fileInput.click()
  370 |           this.formData = new FormData();
  371 |           this.formData.append("file", this.selectedFile);
  372 |         } else {
  373 |           this.$refs.fileInput.click()
  374 |           this.formDataSignature = new FormData();
  375 |           this.formDataSignature.append("file", this.selectedFileSignature);
  376 |         }
  377 |       },
  378 |       async acceptEdit() {
  379 |         if (this.selectedFile) {
  380 |           const formData = new FormData()
  381 |           formData.append("file", this.selectedFile)
  382 |           const result = await this.sendUserImageFile(formData)
  383 |           this.itemEdit.url_photo = result
  384 |         }
  385 |         if (this.selectedFileSignature) {
  386 |           const formData = new FormData()
  387 |           formData.append("file", this.selectedFileSignature)
  388 |           const result = await this.sendUserImageFile(formData)
  389 |           this.itemEdit.url_signature = result
  390 |         }
  391 |         if (this.changePassword) this.itemEdit.password = this.password
  392 |         if (this.confirmSignature) this.itemEdit.passwordSignature = this.claveSignature
  393 |         this.$emit('accept-edit', this.itemEdit)
  394 |       },
  395 |       activePassword() {
  396 |         this.$refs.form.validate()
  397 |       },
  398 |       activeSignature() {
  399 |         this.$refs.form.validate()
  400 |       }
  401 |     },
  402 |   }

  218 |     methods: {

  221 |         },
  222 |         async getUserData() {

  224 |             this.emailUser = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(this.user.email))
  225 |             this.imgUser = `${this.basePath}/images/${JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(this.user.url_photo))}`
  226 |         },
  227 |         async changeData() {
  228 |             if (this.verifyData()) {

  231 |                     const formData = new FormData()
  232 |                     formData.append("file", this.selectedFile)
  233 |                     const result = await this.sendUserImageFile(formData)
  234 |                     newChange.url_photo = result
  235 |                 }
  236 |                 delete newChange.id
  237 |                 delete newChange.token
  238 |                 delete newChange.password
  239 |                 delete newChange.createdAt
  240 |                 delete newChange.updatedAt
  241 |                 if (this.changePassword) {

  244 |                 newChange.user_name = newChange.user_name.toLowerCase()
  245 |                 console.log('newChange: ', newChange)
  246 |                 const resultU = await this.changeUserById(this.user.id, newChange)
  247 |                 if (resultU) {

  249 |                     if (existeNombre) {

  251 |                         return

  253 |                     this.$emit('change-user')
  254 |                 }
  255 |             } else {
  256 |                 this.errorChange = true
  257 |             }
  258 |             
  259 |             
  260 |         },
  261 |         async verifyData() {
  262 |             let isTrue = true
  263 |             if (this.user.name === '') isTrue = false
  264 |             if (this.user.user_name === '') isTrue = false
  265 |             if (this.user.email === '') isTrue = false
  266 |             if (this.user.position === '') isTrue = false
  267 |             if (this.user.telephone === '') isTrue = false
  268 |             if (this.changePassword) {
  269 |                 if (this.newPassword1 === '') isTrue = false
  270 |                 if (!this.passwordsMatch()) isTrue = false
  271 |             }
  272 |             return isTrue
  273 |         },

   61 | <script>
   62 | import laboratoryMixin from '@/mixins/services/laboratoryMixin'

   82 |       default: '',
   83 |     },
   84 |   },
   85 |   data() {
   86 |     return {
   87 |       headers: [
   88 |         {text: 'Sec. / #', align: 'start', value: 'patient_position'},
   89 |         {text: 'Paciente', align: 'start', value: 'name'},
   90 |         {text: 'Edad', align: 'start', value: 'age'},
   91 |         {text: 'Sexo', align: 'start', value: 'sex'},
   92 |         {text: 'Hora ingreso', align: 'start', value: 'admission_time'},
   93 |         {text: 'Teléfono', align: 'start', value: 'phone'},
   94 |         {text: '', value: 'data-table-expand' },
   95 |       ],
   96 |       singleExpand: true,
   97 |       singleSelect: false,
   98 |       selected: [],

  102 |   methods: {
  103 |     listExam(exams) {

  109 |     },    
  110 |     currentDate() {
  111 |       const fecha = new Date()
  112 |       const anio = fecha.getFullYear()
  113 |       var mes = fecha.getMonth() + 1
  114 |       var dia = fecha.getDate()
  115 |       if (mes < 10) {
  116 |           mes = "0" + mes
  117 |       }
  118 |       if (dia < 10) {
  119 |           dia = "0" + dia
  120 |       }
  121 |       const fechaActual = anio + "-" + mes + "-" + dia
  122 |       return fechaActual
  123 |     },
  124 |     async activePrint() {
  125 |       const result = await this.getLaboratorySetting()
  126 |       var worksheeFormat = result.workshee_format
  127 |       var bodyWorkshee = `<table width="100%" border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" role="presentation" style="margin-top: 10px;">

  134 |                 </td>

  136 |                    <div style="display: flex;flex-direction: column;">
  137 |                         <strong>Paciente</strong>
  138 |                         [name_patient]
  139 |                     </div>
  140 |                 </td>
  141 |                 <td style="width: 15%;vertical-align: top;text-align: left;padding: 5px;border-bottom: 2px solid black;">
  142 |                    <div style="display: flex;flex-direction: column;">
  143 |                         <strong>Edad</strong>
  144 |                         [age_patient]
  145 |                     </div>
  146 |                 </td>
  147 |                 <td style="width: 15%;vertical-align: top;text-align: left;padding: 5px;border-bottom: 2px solid black;">
  148 |                    <div style="display: flex;flex-direction: column;">
  149 |                         <strong>Sexo</strong>
  150 |                         [sex_patient]
  151 |                     </div>
  152 |                 </td>
  153 |                 <td style="width: 15%;vertical-align: top;text-align: left;padding: 5px;border-bottom: 2px solid black;">
  154 |                    <div style="display: flex;flex-direction: column;">
  155 |                         <strong>Hora ingreso</strong>
  156 |                         [time_patient]
  157 |                     </div>
  158 |                 </td>

  160 |                    <div style="display: flex;flex-direction: column;">
  161 |                         <strong>Teléfono</strong>
  162 |                         [phone_patient]
  163 |                     </div>
  164 |                 </td>
  165 |               </tr>
  166 |               <tr>
  167 |                   <td colspan="6" style="vertical-align: top;text-align: left;padding: 5px;">
  168 |                     <div style="display: flex;flex-direction: column;">
  169 |                           <strong>Observación</strong>
  170 |                           [observacion]
  171 |                       </div>
  172 |                   </td>
  173 |               </tr>
  174 |                 <tr>

  177 |                         [text_ht]
  178 |                       </div>
  179 |                   </td>
  180 |                 </tr>
  181 |             </table>`
  182 |       worksheeFormat = worksheeFormat.replace('[name_workshee]', this.nameWorkshee )
  183 |       worksheeFormat = worksheeFormat.replace('[fecha]', this.dateWorkshee )
  184 |       worksheeFormat = worksheeFormat.replace('[fecha_actual]', this.currentDate())
  185 |       var parrafo = ''
  186 |       await this.asyncForEach(this.selected, async (item) => {

  188 |         textRow = textRow.replace('[reg]', `${item.patient_position} / ${item.id}` )

  193 |         textRow = textRow.replace('[phone_patient]', `${item.phone}` )
  194 |         textRow = textRow.replace('[observacion]', `${item.observation}` )
  195 |         var textExa = await this.createTextExa(item.exams)
  196 |         textRow = textRow.replace('[text_ht]', textExa)
  197 |         parrafo += textRow
  198 |       })
  199 |       worksheeFormat = worksheeFormat.replace('[body]', parrafo)
  200 |       var miDiv = document.getElementById("printV")
  201 |       miDiv.innerHTML= ''

  205 |       this.voucherOculto = await false

  207 |       for (var i = 0; i < paragraphs.length; i++) {

  211 |       this.voucherOculto = true
  212 |     },       
  213 |     async asyncForEach(array, callback) {
  214 |         for (let index = 0; index < array.length; index++) {

  216 |         }
  217 |     },
  218 |     async createTextExa(listExa) {
  219 |       var textExa = ''
  220 |       var textCount = 0
  221 |       await this.asyncForEach(listExa, async (item) => {
  222 |         var nodo = await this.selectGroup.filter((nodo) => nodo.examId === item.examlistsId)
  223 |         if (textCount + nodo[0].work_sheet.length > 100) {
  224 |           textExa += '<br>'
  225 |           textExa += nodo[0].work_sheet
  226 |           textCount = 0
  227 |         } else {
  228 |           textExa += `${nodo[0].work_sheet} `
  229 |           textCount += nodo[0].work_sheet.length
  230 |         }
  231 |       })
  232 |       return textExa
  233 |     },
  234 |   },
  235 | }

  116 | <script>
  117 | import Dashboard from '@/components/Dashboard.vue'
  118 | import loginMixin from '@/mixins/services/loginMixin'
  119 | import EditUserDialog from '@/components/modules/users/EditUserDialog.vue'
  120 | import { basePath } from '@/config';
  121 | 
  122 | export default {
  123 |     name: 'SuiteLayout',
  124 |     components: { Dashboard, EditUserDialog },
  125 |     mixins: [loginMixin],
  126 |     data() {
  127 |         return {
  128 |             basePath,
  129 |             menu: false,
  130 |             users: null,
  131 |             activeEditUsuer: false,
  132 |             isFullScreen: false,
  133 |         }
  134 |     },
  135 |     async mounted() {
  136 |         const id = localStorage.clientId
  137 |         this.users = await this.getLoginToclientId(id)
  138 |         if (!localStorage.token) {
  139 |             this.logout()
  140 |         } else {
  141 |             if (!this.verifyDates(localStorage.dateIn)) {
  142 |                 this.logout()
  143 |             } 
  144 |         }
  145 |     },
  146 |     methods: {
  147 |         verifyDates(dateIn) {
  148 |             const fecha1 = new Date()
  149 |             const fecha2 = new Date(dateIn)
  150 |             const diferenciaEnMilisegundos = Math.abs(fecha2 - fecha1)
  151 |             if (diferenciaEnMilisegundos > 86400000) {
  152 |                 return false
  153 |             }
  154 |             return true
  155 |         },
  156 |         logout() {
  157 |             localStorage.clear()
  158 |             const client = {
  159 |                   id: null,
  160 |                   name: '',
  161 |                   roles: '',
  162 |                   token: "[REDACTED]",
  163 |                   college: '',
  164 |                   position: '',
  165 |                   photo: null,
  166 |                   telephone: '',
  167 |                   email: ''
  168 |                }
  169 |             this.$store.commit('setClient', client)
  170 |             this.$router.replace({name:'login'})
  171 |         },
  172 |         changeUser() {
  173 |             this.activeEditUsuer = false
  174 |             this.logout()
  175 |         },
  176 |         toggleFullScreen() {
  177 |             if (!document.fullscreenElement) {
  178 |                 // Activar pantalla completa
  179 |                 document.documentElement.requestFullscreen().then(() => {
  180 |                     this.isFullScreen = true;
  181 |                 }).catch((err) => {
  182 |                     console.error(`Error al intentar activar pantalla completa: ${err.message}`);
  183 |                 });
  184 |             } else {
  185 |                 // Salir de pantalla completa
  186 |                 document.exitFullscreen().then(() => {
  187 |                     this.isFullScreen = false;
  188 |                 }).catch((err) => {
  189 |                     console.error(`Error al intentar salir de pantalla completa: ${err.message}`);
  190 |                 });
  191 |             }
  192 |         }
  193 |     },
  194 | }
  195 | </script>
  196 | <style scoped>
  197 | .border-img {
  198 |     border: 1px solid gray;
  199 | }

  201 |     border-radius: 50%;

  203 |     height: inherit;
  204 |     width: inherit;
  205 |     border: 1px solid gray;
  206 |     height: 40px; min-width: 40px; width: 40px;
  207 | }
  208 | </style>

  140 |   <script>
  141 |   import pacientsMixin from '@/mixins/services/pacientsMixin'
  142 |   import groupHTMixin from '@/mixins/services/groupHTMixin'
  143 |   import loginMixin from '@/mixins/services/loginMixin'
  144 |   import laboratoryMixin from '@/mixins/services/laboratoryMixin'
  145 |   import waypayMixin from '@/mixins/services/waypayMixin'
  146 |   import functionMixin from '@/mixins/util/functionMixin'
  147 |   import NewDollarDialog from '@/components/modules/admission/NewDollarDialog.vue'
  148 |   import { basePath } from '@/config';
  149 | 
  150 |   export default {
  151 |     name: 'Home',
  152 |     components: {NewDollarDialog},
  153 |     mixins: [
  154 |         pacientsMixin,
  155 |         groupHTMixin,
  156 |         loginMixin,
  157 |         laboratoryMixin,
  158 |         waypayMixin,
  159 |         functionMixin,
  160 |       ],
  161 |     data() {
  162 |       return {
  163 |         basePath,
  164 |         desde: this.getFirstDayOfMonth(),
  165 |         hasta: this.getLastDayOfMonth(),
  166 |         actual: this.getCurrentDate(),
  167 |         laboratoryName: '',
  168 |         imgLab: null,
  169 |         totalMes: 0,
  170 |         totalDia: 0,
  171 |         groupHT: [],
  172 |         intervalId: null,
  173 |         value: 0,
  174 |         interval: {},
  175 |         roleUser: [],
  176 |         dollarValue: null,
  177 |         newDollar: false,
  178 |         items: [
  179 |           {
  180 |             title: 'Historia',
  181 |             icon: 'mdi-clipboard-text-clock-outline',
  182 |             link: { name: 'PatientHistory' },
  183 |             role: ['user', 'admin']
  184 |           },
  185 |           {
  186 |             title: 'Ingreso de pacientes',
  187 |             icon: 'mdi-account-plus',
  188 |             link: { name: 'PatientAdmission' },
  189 |             role: ['user', 'admin'],
  190 |           },
  191 |           {
  192 |             title: 'Hoja de trabajo',
  193 |             icon: 'mdi-file-document-edit-outline',
  194 |             link: { name: 'Worksheet' },
  195 |             role: ['user', 'admin'],
  196 |           },
  197 |           {
  198 |             title: 'Aprobar resultados',
  199 |             icon: 'mdi-file-sign',
  200 |             link: { name: 'PatientApprove' },
  201 |             role: ['user', 'admin'],
  202 |           },
  203 |           {
  204 |             title: 'Entrega resultados por email',
  205 |             icon: 'mdi-send-check-outline',
  206 |             link: { name: 'ResultsByEmail' },
  207 |             role: ['user', 'admin'],
  208 |           }
  209 |         ],
  210 |       }
  211 |     },
  212 |     async created() {
  213 |       const id = localStorage.clientId
  214 |       const result = await this.getLoginToclientId(id)
  215 |       if (result) {
  216 |         this.roleUser = result.roles.split(',')
  217 |       }
  218 |       this.getLaboratory()
  219 |     },
  220 |     mounted() {
  221 |       this.updateTime()
  222 |       this.intervalId = setInterval(this.updateTime, 60000)
  223 |       this.getDollar()
  224 |     },
  225 |     beforeDestroy() {
  226 |       if (this.intervalId) {
  227 |         clearInterval(this.intervalId)
  228 |       }
  229 |     },
  230 |     methods: {
  231 |       async getLaboratory() {
  232 |         const result = await this.getLaboratorySetting()
  233 |         if (result) {
  234 |           this.laboratoryName = result.name
  235 |           this.imgLab = `${result.logo}`
  236 |         }
  237 |       },
  238 |       getFirstDayOfMonth() {
  239 |         const date = new Date()
  240 |         const year = date.getFullYear()
  241 |         const month = String(date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')
  242 |         const day = '01'
  243 |         return `${year}-${month}-${day}`
  244 |       },
  245 |       getLastDayOfMonth() {
  246 |         const date = new Date()
  247 |         const year = date.getFullYear()
  248 |         const month = date.getMonth() + 1
  249 |         const lastDay = new Date(year, month, 0).getDate()
  250 |         const formattedMonth = String(month).padStart(2, '0')
  251 |         const formattedDay = String(lastDay).padStart(2, '0')
  252 |         return `${year}-${formattedMonth}-${formattedDay}`
  253 |       },
  254 |       getCurrentDate() {
  255 |         const date = new Date()
  256 |         const year = date.getFullYear()
  257 |         const month = String(date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')
  258 |         const day = String(date.getDate()).padStart(2, '0')
  259 |         return `${year}-${month}-${day}`;
  260 |       },
  261 |       async calculateTotals(desde, hasta) {
  262 |         const newMonth = {
  263 |           firstDate: desde,
  264 |           lastDate: hasta,
  265 |         }
  266 |         const result = await this.getTotalPatientsMonth(newMonth)
  267 |         return result
  268 |       },
  269 |       async calculategroupHT() {
  270 |         this.groupHT= []
  271 |         var result = await this.getGroupHtListActive()
  272 |         if (result) {
  273 |           result = await result.map(item => ({
  274 |             ...item,
  275 |             grouphtitems: item.grouphtitems.map(group => ({
  276 |               examId: group.examId
  277 |             }))
  278 |           }))
  279 |         }
  280 |         await this.asyncForEach(result, async (group) => {
  281 |           const texto = []
  282 |           await this.asyncForEach(group.grouphtitems, async (exa) => {
  283 |             texto.push(parseInt(exa.examId, 10))
  284 |           })
  285 |           if (texto !== '') {
  286 |             const newQuery = {
  287 |               examIds: texto,
  288 |               firstDate: this.actual,
  289 |               lastDate: this.actual,
  290 |             }
  291 |             const resultEx = await this.getTotalExamWithGroup(newQuery)
  292 |             if (resultEx) {
  293 |               group.total = parseInt(resultEx.total, 10)
  294 |               group.total_recorded = parseInt(resultEx.total_recorded, 10)
  295 |             }
  296 |           }
  297 |         })
  298 |         this.groupHT = result
  299 |       },
  300 |       async updateTime() {
  301 |         try {
  302 |           this.totalMes = await this.calculateTotals(this.desde, this.hasta)
  303 |           this.totalDia = await this.calculateTotals(this.actual, this.actual)
  304 |           this.calculategroupHT()
  305 |         } catch (error) {
  306 |           console.error(error);
  307 |         }
  308 |       },
  309 |       async asyncForEach(array, callback) {
  310 |         for (let index = 0; index < array.length; index++) {
  311 |           await callback(array[index], index, array);
  312 |         }
  313 |       },
  314 |       async getDollar() {
  315 |         const result = await this.getDollarValue()
  316 |         if (result) {
  317 |           this.dollarValue = result
  318 |           const date = this.dollarValue.date
  319 |           this.dollarValue.date = date.split('T')[0]
  320 |         }
  321 |       },
  322 |       async activeNewDollar(dolar) {
  323 |         this.newDollar = false
  324 |         if (dolar !== '') {
  325 |           dolar = dolar.toString()
  326 |           dolar = dolar.replace('.', '')
  327 |           dolar = dolar.replace(',', '.')
  328 |           if (isNaN(dolar) === false) {
  329 |             const newValue = { value: dolar, }
  330 |             const result = await this.setNewDolar(newValue)
  331 |             if (result) {
  332 |                 this.getDollar()
  333 |             }
  334 |           }
  335 |         }
  336 |       }, 
  337 |     },
  338 |   }
  339 |   </script>

  144 | <script>
  145 |   import QueriesTable from '@/components/modules/movements/QueriesTable.vue'
  146 |   import CreateInvoice from '@/components/modules/movements/CreateInvoice.vue'
  147 |   import pacientsMixin from '@/mixins/services/pacientsMixin'
  148 |   import waypayMixin from '@/mixins/services/waypayMixin'
  149 |   import functionMixin from '@/mixins/util/functionMixin'
  150 |   import NewDollarDialog from '@/components/modules/admission/NewDollarDialog.vue'
  151 | 
  152 |   export default {
  153 |     name: 'AccountsReceivable',
  154 |     components: {QueriesTable, CreateInvoice, NewDollarDialog},
  155 |     mixins: [pacientsMixin, functionMixin, waypayMixin],
  156 |     data() {
  157 |       return {
  158 |         menuDate: false,
  159 |         date: [],
  160 |         clientSelection: 0,
  161 |         listClient: [],
  162 |         newQuery: null,
  163 |         total: 0,
  164 |         totalDollars: 0,
  165 |         dollarValue: null,
  166 |         showSelect: true,
  167 |         selected: [],
  168 |         selectedId: [],
  169 |         createInvoice: false,
  170 |         newDollar: false,
  171 |         registerCreateInvoice: false,
  172 |         activeRegisterCreateInvoice: false,
  173 |       }
  174 |     },
  175 |     watch: {
  176 |       'date': {
  177 |         handler() {
  178 |           this.generateQuery()
  179 |         },
  180 |       },
  181 |     },
  182 |     computed: {
  183 |       dateRangeText () {
  184 |         return this.date.join(' ~ ')
  185 |       },
  186 |     },
  187 |     async mounted() {
  188 |       await this.searchClientList()
  189 |       await this.getDollar()
  190 |       await this.getDate()
  191 |     },
  192 |     methods: {
  193 |       getDate() {
  194 |         const now = new Date();
  195 |         const firstDate = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), 1)
  196 |         const lastDate = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth() + 1, 0)
  197 |         this.date.push(this.formatDateToYYYYMMDD(firstDate))
  198 |         this.date.push(this.formatDateToYYYYMMDD(lastDate))
  199 |       },
  200 |       async getDollar() {
  201 |         const result = await this.getDollarValue()
  202 |         if (result) {
  203 |           this.dollarValue = result
  204 |           const date = this.dollarValue.date
  205 |           this.dollarValue.date = date.split('T')[0]
  206 |         }
  207 |       },
  208 |       async searchClientList() {
  209 |         let result = await this.getClientList()
  210 |         if (result) {
  211 |           result = result.filter(item => item.id !== 1)
  212 |           this.listClient = result.map(({ id, business_name }) => ({ id, business_name }))
  213 |         }
  214 |         if (this.listClient.length !== 0) {
  215 |           this.clientSelection = this.listClient[0].id
  216 |         }          
  217 |       },
  218 |       async generateQuery() {
  219 |         var firstDate
  220 |         var lastDate
  221 |         if (this.date.length !== 0) {
  222 |           firstDate = this.date[0]
  223 |           lastDate = this.date[1]
  224 |         } else if (this.date.length === 1) {
  225 |           firstDate = this.date[0]
  226 |           lastDate = this.date[0]
  227 |         }
  228 |         this.newQuery = await {
  229 |           firstDate: firstDate,
  230 |           lastDate: lastDate,
  231 |           namePatient: '',
  232 |           userSelection: 0,
  233 |           clientSelection: this.clientSelection,
  234 |           clientSelectionStatus: 0,
  235 |           ciPatient: '',
  236 |           invoice: true,
  237 |         }
  238 |         const result = await this.getPatientsWithQueriesTotal(this.newQuery)
  239 |         if (result) {
  240 |           this.total = result.total
  241 |           this.totalDollars = Math.round(result.total / this.dollarValue.value)
  242 |         }
  243 |       },
  244 |       formatDateToYYYYMMDD(date) {
  245 |         const year = date.getFullYear()
  246 |         const month = String(date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')
  247 |         const day = String(date.getDate()).padStart(2, '0')
  248 |         return `${year}-${month}-${day}`
  249 |       },
  250 |       selectedQuantity(value) {
  251 |         this.selected = value
  252 |       },
  253 |       activateCreateInvoice() {
  254 |         this.selectedId = this.selected.map(objeto => objeto.id)
  255 |         this.createInvoice = true
  256 |       },      
  257 |       async activeNewDollar(dolar) {
  258 |         this.newDollar = false
  259 |         if (dolar !== '') {
  260 |           dolar = dolar.toString()
  261 |           dolar = dolar.replace('.', '')
  262 |           dolar = dolar.replace(',', '.')
  263 |           if (isNaN(dolar) === false) {
  264 |             const newValue = { value: dolar, }
  265 |             const result = await this.setNewDolar(newValue)
  266 |             if (result) {
  267 |                 this.getDollar()
  268 |             }
  269 |           }
  270 |         }
  271 |       }, 
  272 |       activatePrintRegister() {
  273 |         console.log('activatePrintRegister')
  274 |       },
  275 |       closeInvoice() {
  276 |         this.createInvoice=false
  277 |         this.selected=[]
  278 |       },
  279 |       btnRegisterCreateInvoice() {
  280 |         this.activeRegisterCreateInvoice = true
  281 |         this.registerCreateInvoice = true
  282 |       },
  283 |       async recordReceivables(listFact) {
  284 |         await this.asyncForEach(this.selectedId, async (item) => {
  285 |           const newChange = {
  286 |             invoice: listFact,
  287 |           }
  288 |           await this.updatePatient(item, newChange)
  289 |         })
  290 |         this.activeRegisterCreateInvoice = false
  291 |         this.closeInvoice()
  292 |       },
  293 |       async asyncForEach(array, callback) {
  294 |         for (let index = 0; index < array.length; index++) {
  295 |           await callback(array[index], index, array);
  296 |         }
  297 |       },
  298 |     },
  299 |   }
  300 | </script>

  104 | <script>
  105 | import antibioticMixin  from '@/mixins/services/antibioticMixin'
  106 | 
  107 | export default {
  108 |     name: 'AntibioticConfiguration',
  109 |     mixins: [antibioticMixin],
  110 |     data() {
  111 |         return {
  112 |             saveLoad: false,
  113 |             drawer: true,
  114 |             activeSetting: false,
  115 |             listAntibiotic: null,
  116 |             selectItem: null,
  117 |             newRecord: 0,
  118 |         }
  119 |     },
  120 |     async mounted() {
  121 |       await this.getAntibioticList()
  122 |     },
  123 |     methods: {
  124 |         async setAntibiotic() {
  125 |             this.saveLoad = true
  126 |             await Promise.all(this.listAntibiotic.map(item => this.processItem(item)))
  127 |             this.saveLoad = false
  128 |         },
  129 |         changeUpper(type) {
  130 |             if (type === 'description') {
  131 |                 this.selectItem.description = this.selectItem.description.toUpperCase()
  132 |             }
  133 |             if (type === 'siglas') {
  134 |                 this.selectItem.siglas = this.selectItem.siglas.toUpperCase()
  135 |             }            
  136 |         },
  137 |         async processItem(element) {
  138 |             const id = element.id
  139 |             const newItem = {
  140 |                 description: element.description,
  141 |                 siglas: element.siglas,
  142 |                 annulled: element.annulled,
  143 |             }
  144 |             let result = null
  145 |             if (id < 0) {
  146 |                 result = await this.createAntibiotic(newItem)
  147 |                 if (result) element.id = result.id
  148 |             } else {
  149 |                 result = await this.updateAntibiotic(id, newItem)
  150 |             }
  151 |         },
  152 |         async getAntibioticList() {
  153 |             this.listAntibiotic = await this.getAntibioticLists()
  154 |             this.changeActive()
  155 |         },
  156 |         changeActive() {
  157 |             this.listAntibiotic.forEach(element => {
  158 |                 element.active = false
  159 |             });
  160 |         },
  161 |         async activeSelected(element) {
  162 |             await this.changeActive()
  163 |             element.active = true
  164 |             this.selectItem = element
  165 |             this.activeSetting = true
  166 |         },
  167 |         newAntibiotic() {
  168 |             this.changeActive()
  169 |             this.newRecord += 1
  170 |             const newElement = {
  171 |                 id: this.newRecord * -1,
  172 |                 description: `NUEVO ${this.newRecord}`,
  173 |                 siglas: '',
  174 |                 annulled: false,
  175 |                 active: true,
  176 |             }
  177 |             this.listAntibiotic.push(newElement)
  178 |             this.selectItem = newElement
  179 |             this.activeSetting = true
  180 |         },
  181 |         cancelAntibiotic() {
  182 |             const index = this.listAntibiotic.findIndex(item=> item === this.selectItem.id)
  183 |             this.listAntibiotic.splice(index, 1)
  184 |             this.activeSetting = false
  185 |         },
  186 |     },
  187 | }
  188 | </script>
